text: Ahketeware piʼi piʼkawachinsu, iʼshana yunsan wenseate kehparitawa, inake shaʼwichitun irahka unpuinta kemupinewe paʼsarawe iterawe.
Aʼpayatunma kaʼtanku ihsu ira nahpunin, nuhsururaema, uʼnankeran achihpiruterin nahpatun kahsu uhsharan paʼsarawe, kanuhtupirawe nihpirinwe nuya kankanterawe.
Tatamahshu nahatanke kuʼwara tanan ya yaʼkunasu.

¿Nituhteran tanansu nihshaterin uʼnanpachinsu, waʼwa? Ira chihpirutuwachinsu, ¿aʼnarumare tuʼkuwiterewa? Irahka yunkirawe mamanewe kewan nuninke tunpurinku ama chiwekamare. ¿Ku kemanta inapuchin nuwanteran nitaimare? Tananke ya chiwerahpiranwe. ¿Kuʼna iʼsha irininsu imate naniterewa nunshinanke kanakasu?

¿Yunkiran kema ina mahshuya ihpurawanta nahpuru miʼse nunshake paʼpisu yunkirin?Nani semana nininke mercado pantaʼpi kepapi, irahkaraware tatamahshu inawatun nanpirin. ¿Kuʼna nihka nahpuru paʼterinsu nanpewachinsu nahpuruwarw uʼmarewa? Ina kurihki yamuramare shapumare ninin. ¿Inseketa ina kemapiruʼsa nihsapi chinihke ni seʼkeatuna pen yaʼkaria wenseatuna wensepi?
Aʼna ninanuke kanuhtukeran nimara inkanarawe, tahshiriamiachinkeran iraterawe ku nituhterawe ahketeware nimara kanuhtu awantamare.

¿Niʼnan tahshiachin iʼshana wishwani imuterin, waʼwa? Ku nuya niʼpatansu ¿naniteran chiwekamare? Yunkirawe tatanewe aʼchinterinku inairaruʼsa perahtupisu nahtanawatu naniterawe uʼmakasu. ¿Taʼtuwatansu nanitaran tanan nunterinsu nahtamare? Chiwewatansu, ¿kuʼna nihka iʼsha irininsu paʼmarinsu yuniran?

Peʼnate paʼmawatu, taʼnanewe nuya suʼpinawatun keparawe. Nimara irateraweke kahtu taweri nihkapun nahpatun naʼku kanuhtarawe. nahpatun itaranken ama peʼpetekesu maʼsha ku kahtawararinkesu. Inapihkeran yusparinke itaranku nuyahpiachin weʼeransumare.
Iʼnaransu imatun nuwiteranke nunsha kepararinke.
Nimara yuʼnananen aresemare paʼanapun.
Ina nuʼwiterinkeran inaran yusparin tenin.
Mamapayaraʼwa, ¿unpuatunta vecina niwi kehsha mercado paʼneke keterewa? Kemareʼken ina kuhtaru peʼpeterawe. ¿Inapihkeran ina pawereanpu ku nihka nani maʼsha keterinpu? Shaʼwituku mamapaya,

Iʼshanaʼpa paʼmawatusu, taʼnanewe inaran keʼsha keparawe. Tahpuna ya uʼnatahpirawe tananke nanitere weʼekasu. Ku nuya nuwitatun paʼpatansu nahpunin tananke nihsaran. Nahpatun itaranken kuʼwara peikeran ya pihpiasu inawa chihturu niʼkeʼ.
Ku kanpura ihpura tahshi weʼekasu, paʼawa yaʼipinpua kehparitawa ama teʼwatamare.

Ahchin tahshiachin shaʼwirawe pasarawesu tata imahshawe pantaʼpi paʼanamare. Mamapaya aʼpayaku ama inaura ishaʼnepa paʼsaisun. Kayarun kashinuʼsa nihsarinsu wentunku inaran chinuhtuku. Nuya kankankeran kankuwatu chinuhtariwa inake unpuinsuna paʼnawesu shaʼwitaraema.
Aʼshatu, ¿naniterawe keʼsha panka bolsa puʼmurawatu aʼnapita paʼantamare?

Kuʼwara iminke pakasu, pichirewa unpu iraruʼsata yaʼwerin.Chiwewatesu, iʼshana nihsarinke paʼne inaran ina imate iratere. Iʼshanasu kepararinpu ninanuaʼwake yaʼwereke. Nahpatun nahpupinanchin iratuwatere ku teʼwaterewa.
Nimara ina penutun tehkapun nuya ninin waʼwaruʼsa vacuna nitaimare, inapuchin chinihken uʼnankeran ama kañuantamare.

Waʼwa, tahshiraya aʼshatuparinken iʼkeʼpa kaʼtanaran. Ina nimara tamitarinken nunshake sami yaʼwerinsu paʼanamasu. Unpu paʼanpita tatanenpua ina yunkike; nuya nunkatun unpu paʼterinsu shaʼwike, nimara kuʼwara kamuhtechi yaʼihpi paʼanamara.
Nunshake iʼshana imate paʼmararewa. Inake iʼsha uʼusaran inaran pu¿pianteranta chinuhtaran, tanankeʼpaware ahke nihsarin.

Awaitu kamayu shaʼwirin nipayarinsureʼ tahshiriamichin peʼnate paʼmararin. Ina yunkirin nani ya paʼsawachina aʼna ihputu nitawatun pantaʼpi kepamare ketapun. Nahpatun yunkiatun tenin aʼna pamaterinke nahpuru kenantapun.
Ama vecino niwi ketekesu, ahpiaʼwa, ku nitu pawereterinwe.

Tahshira ku kemaura yunsanke paʼsaran wahpuru nitamare. Tanansu tahshiriamichin tahshinanterin ira ku nuya niʼsaran. Ku muhturu kankiasuwe ku nunshanenke paʼmararan, inawatan naʼkun maiteransu kanuhtaran. Ku nuwarinteke yaʼnuikamare waʼwaruʼsa pataran, nuwate ya nuwatahpirinwe. Ku Inapuchin nihpatansu, yaʼipi nuya kankankeran wentararewa.

¿Nani taweri tatamahshuruʼsa tahshiachin mercado nininke panʼtapi kayapi kepapi? inapuchin tatanewe nani semanake ninin, nunsha menta pantaʼpi kematun. ¿Ku nihka yunkiran nahpuru taweri kanpu kemapinpua yunkiresu, tahshiachin pihpikamare? Ku ahkete nahpuru paʼankaimare ku naʼkun aʼpaterewa yaʼihpia nuya ankantaimare. ¿Yaʼwapun nihka irahkapuchin aʼnapita tanankeran kematuna ninanuke kapaimare?
Yusparin tenawe, kuwachi nuʼwiterawe.
Tatahshusu nuya kankaterin aminen kahpa kankankeran suʼsurarinsu, nimara kuwachi nanitapun yuʼnatapun kaʼtanamare.

Ku perarinaku nuhtaparin ikitawachinsu, piʼpisha ku inkanawe. - yuhsemare, naʼkun sehtupirai, ku nituhterai maʼta nihkakasu. - Nihpirinwe nuya waʼwaterin. - Aʼna naʼnei nuya kankankeran pihpiterinku, ma nuyata yaʼipi nuya pihpirin.
Nuhsuruku kantaʼ, kahken waʼwaruʼsa, uʼnaii yaʼkuirinku nahpurawatun chihpiru akanuhterinku; nuyahkeran peike yaʼweraweke ya kankunawe.

¿Nuwanteran aʼna shaʼwi shaʼwitamare sehtaransu naʼwetamare? Nuwanteran karinken mehtenen pehpatamare. ¿Puʼpianteranta tewaitunku inake karinken urunchitenke inairaruʼsa tahshiriamichin nihpisupuchin?
Kanpuarahchin iʼirateke ku pihpikasu, nahpupinanchin nahtanwa tahshi irateruʼsa paʼpisu.

¿Nuʼten nihka ina wiʼnapi niparinsu petehte yaʼwekuntarinsu naʼwanin? Iminke paʼpachinara, ¿yunkirin ni narintupisu? kemupinen nuya nuntupi ama sehtamakare, ¿nuʼten? ¿Nuyahpiachin yaʼwerinsu ina nuya kankanke kepaitun nihka? Nihpirinwe yunkirin tanan ku irininsu puchin kankanterin, ¿ninatarin nahpuru taweri ni kenantakamare?

Tanan kashinuʼsa yunihpatera, iʼshanakeran irateresu pichirewa. Iratereke nahpunin nihsapachinsu, nahkaranchachin iʼshanaʼpa ayantumare ina imakasu. Ishasu ku achiwerinpu. Inapuchin, ahke paʼpirewa nuya kankankeran kankimare
Wankanaike kankunwatera, tawanke nininke nunsha uhkuirarewa. Inake puʼpianteranta kushatariwa inara chinuhtariwa kuʼwara pakasuwe.
Piʼpian iwan ya niirawe, nuhsurankema, ihsu ira ahke nihsarin; kahpa kankanterawe kuʼwara tahshiyasu uʼnanasu peike nihsarawe.

¿Naniteran kareʼken petehte nuhtetakasu? Nimara ina parihchi wahpuru weʼsamara. Nimara kuʼwara tahshitasu kankiramara. Nimara ahke nihsamara. Inta shaʼwituku kunai ku nihka nusu kenanpatansu. Nimara winkinke nihsarinke yaʼtetemara.

¿Nuya kankanchitun yunkiatun nahpu piʼpian tewerahransu? Karinsu ku nuʼwiʼintenke, waʼwa. Nahpunin yunkiransu iʼkeke pachitunwe, inari ahke kepaitun. ¿Ina aʼpuransu ku nihka nuyahsha nitewaitun? Karinken penuitenken tanan werunuʼsake.
Nani vaso nihsarinke nuya nihkatun mentahtaran inaran kirihki nuya tahpararan. Unpuinsuna kiya irahka ninaisu, ku ahkete aʼpataran yaʼihpia piʼnikaimare waʼwa.
Muʼku naʼpiruʼsa imatun iʼshana pentunteke, chihpiru parichi ama pakesu.
Nani taweri aʼna ninanuke paʼnawesu ku ahkete maʼsha kapamare ku kepararawe, piʼi ahketeware piʼkawachinsu ku nanitarawe inkanakasu.
Ku ahkeware nahpunin kankantapun. Tahshiraya paʼsarewa iʼshana nihkamare inake niʼsaran samiraʼwaruʼsa pahshika tuhpisu, nahpuruware nuya kankantaran.
Ama ku paʼterinsu sami paʼankesu, waʼwa.
Ihsu sami peʼpeke ninanukeran kenawesu. Kanuhtukeran ya uʼmarawe kahsu, nihpirinwe kahpa kankankeran yaʼipi pantaʼpinewe paʼanawe.

Irake pantaʼpi nunun piyapiruʼsa aʼnuteke paʼantaimare. Shapun mukaru inaran shipitu nininsu ama maʼpatekesu inasu nahpunin peʼsainkaimare. Nuya yamura nininsu maʼpateke bolsa nuyahpiachin akurwatun tahpake. Nuya yunkiatun nihke ama paʼyankesuwe maʼsharuʼsa maʼpataransumare. Yunkirawe naʼkun aʼnake sanapiruʼsa nunpintupi. Nani uʼmarawatansu maʼsharuʼsa nuya yuntunke.
Tahshiachin pihpirawe inake shaʼwirawe naʼkun taweri paʼsarawesu. Iyaraʼwa, ama panka nara nanpetahkesu, Tata kahtawake nantipi peʼpeke inapihkeran chinuhteke kemanta. Wentawatu iʼkepa yaʼnipirarewa.

¿Kuʼwara ninanuke ya pakasuwe kemupiruʼsa niyuntanawatuna yaʼipi yunkipi sharuʼsa senakaisumare? Inawatun tatasu mercado pantaʼpinen paʼanin yamura kentakamare. ¿Kuʼna nihka kema yunkiran unpu ninuntatuna maʼsha nihpisu? Yaʼpiranenpu ni nihsawate paʼterinsu ni shaʼwiterewa. ¿Inseketa ina tawerianpiteresu ninin tatamahshuruʼsa iiwayan nunapirirn nuyahsha nunshake paʼmatewa inkanamare?

Awaitu kamayusu shaʼwiatun napurin taweri yaʼkaria mahpintun kemapisu paʼsarin. Ina yunkirin maʼsha puʼmui nitawatun aʼkarawatun nuya pake itapun. Ina kemapisu nuhsha chinpi kemapun inapuchin inakeran naʼkun yunkipun.
Ku manta iʼshake paʼanan.

Aʼna ninanuaʼwake kanpatera, nimara ku insharu ninarinpua. Uhsharan piyapiʼsa nunterai, ku nihka nahtaninkui. Kehken maʼshanewita peʼperai. Nani nimara ahpiruʼsa iminke paʼpi yaʼwere kiyahsu yunkirapiterai.
Nuya kankankeran yunkirai ihsu tahshike peike inkanakasu, nunenameruʼsa waʼwanarinsu uʼukamare.
¿Unputa nahtantariwa aʼna nunun mare? Ku naʼkuyan aʼpatuwatera, ¿inaran unpu paweretere ahpi kurihki aʼnanesu iiyunsanke yaʼwerinsu?
¿Kahkeran nuya nihka kema kayapin paʼaitun? Irahka iyawe chinihke mercado nininke shaʼwirin yaʼipi paʼankamare.
Ku pantaʼpi keʼshamare ku niketariwe.
Kunpanewe ku pantaʼpi ni kanpiaraiwe
Ku bolsake keʼsha puʼmurawe.
Tanan kashinu paʼa saminen ni kanpiawa, inapuchin ya ninewa. Kareʼken paʼa ninanuke, ka ira nuwiterawe.

¿Unpu kahtawainkensu kema ahku ikiteransu ku shaʼwituwatanku? Ku tahpantu shaʼwituwatankusu, ka nara iteʼ sehtu nuneninsu yuniitu. ¿Nuya kankanchitun shaʼwiran nahpurini? Karinken yaʼihpi iʼwaraya nahtainten.
Ku aʼnarahchin ahke ninanukeran weʼsarawe.
Nunshinaʼpa kankunpata, waniatun iʼsha taʼirinsu nuya niʼke.
¿Nuwanteran kahtenpu tuminku taweri uskuru mercado nininke kepakasu, irahka ninesu puchin mamanenpure maʼsha paʼaneke?

¿Unpuinta nihka sanapisu kankaterin waʼwin ihpuraware iratarinsu nihpachinara? Ina tenin nuyahpiachin kankaterin waʼwin nihkatun aʼnataweri nuya kemapi nihkapun. ¿Kuʼna nihka nahpuru waʼwin nihkatun nuya kankanterin?
Unpua, waʼwanewe. Iʼwara anpu iʼshanaruʼsa tatawarinenke pentuiterama. Kentaran pantapi inaran naʼkun nuya kankantu.¡Nuya kakanterawe niʼsarankensumare!

Mamaparin ku nuwanterinwe ninunenkamare, naʼkun inamare paʼyanpirawe. -Nuʼwitunin, ku insharu nahtaninwe. -Inapihkeran paʼnin nahpatun ihpura nani nitewarin. -Nuʼten, kuwachi tahshi tuku teninwe, nuya wachi yaʼihpi kankanterai.
Unpua, sanapiaʼwa. Uhshin yuʼyawanen nunterin ina inaura kehpariterin yaʼipi tahshi uʼnaninke, inaran ihpurin ama ahkete naʼnekamare.
¿Nuya kankanchitun nihka yuʼyuparin nunterawe nihka? Kari nunchitu ku niweitui. ¿Nimara kanpu kemupinewe ninewasu nuya ninuntate yaʼwekasu? kahtaʼwainken nuya kankanuʼsa ya¿wechima, ama sehtekesu.

Weʼkama iterai nunshakeran pihpirawatui, nimara ku nuya nahtaninkui. Nara yamuaninke nininke ninaterai, ku nituhtatui insharu weʼsamara. Maʼshanenpita ii yunsanke shipi kehpariterin ku yaʼwerinwe insharuteranta kahtawakui itakasu.
Nimara uʼmananke ihsu iʼshana yunkirarewa.
¿Puʼpianteranta akurarewa samire ku nihpun keʼshare niketakamare, ku nihka yaʼihpi kurihkimare ninanuke paʼanariwa?
Ku nuyawe kanpura tahshi pihkikamare, niyuntunate pihkpire tahshi ku teʼwatamare.
Ku ahkete peʼpetu ahke kepararawe.
¿Unpuita kahsu, ninanu uruntereke kahtawarawesu, niwi yamura maʼpaterawesu ina tananke maʼsha mahkatu pawereʼitunke?
Ku naniantarai naʼkun ni nuhsururesu, iterin; ahke paʼpiraunta, ninupinenpua ni nuhsurapuna, naʼkun ni yunkitarewa irahka niyakawaresu.
¿Unpatunta yunu piʼipuchin ya kankunin aʼna ninanuaʼwake? Mukaru muhturu yaʼwetatun inaran ahke nimantarin ku irahka puchin nininwe.

Yunkirawe irahka wiʼnapitapu irateraweke, ku insharu ira aʼnuterinku. Iʼshasu ahke paʼnin ku nuwituwatera nunpinterinpua. Paʼnaweke kahsu kuʼwara pihpiasu mahshuruʼsa nahtanawe. Kemanta nihka naniteran nahtankamare waʼwa, irasu ku nuya paʼninsu akunuhtarin.
Nimara ku nuya iʼwasuwe paʼmararewa.
Paʼanapi sanapi ku saminen puʼpian yamuramare ku saminen ketapun. Aʼnari ku ahketemiachin ku pawerepachinsu ku saminen ketapun. Yunkirin mercado ninink kepamare inake yunkirin ahketware aʼpatapun.
Ku mercado maʼsha kenanawe.

Ihsu tuminku nimara iyamahsunen atari kayu paʼanamare kahtawararan. Aʼnea aʼnea bolsa nininke akuraran ama irake nipaʼpuikasu. Unpu paʼterinta shaʼwiaran, ku ahkete aʼpataran, irahka tatamahshunenpu aʼchinterinpuasu.
Senaraweran pihkeran ninanuʼpa paʼmarawe shiʼshi paʼanamare. Kaʼtanku, waʼwa, mana aʼna kashin paʼanchinke.

¿Yunkiran waʼwa, unpuinsuna tatamahshunen nani iʼshana tanan nininsu nuwiterin? Kemaura nunshake yaʼkunpatan ¿ku teʼwateran chiwekamare? Irahka kanta ihsu iraruʼsa iraterawe nunemeruʼsa yunitu nunekamare. ¿Kuʼna nihka piʼi niʼnan nituhtakamare insechinta nunshinan kehpariterinsu? Chiwewatansu, ¿ninateran insharu mairakeran naʼwerarinsu? Inapuchin nihkatun peike kansaran, inapuchin ka ninawe.

¿Kuʼna nihka tatanenpu yaʼipi piyapiruʼsa yuntunatun yunkipi ma tawerita mercado nininke pakaimare? Inapita mini imin kashinuʼsa senapi tehkein nuyawa nihsarinke kepataimare. ¿Kuʼna nihka yunkiran unputa kurihki aʼpaterewa nani nantipi paʼanewake? Inake mini yaʼwerin yamura tuma paʼanakamare. ¿Yaʼwapun nihka ina taweri nininsu kemapiruʼsa uruntatuna uʼmapisu, nuya kankankeran yunkiatuna kemapi kapini nuya ninuntupisu?
¡Iʼwata, waʼwaraʼwanewe! Naʼkun iʼshanaruʼsa kehken iwe peʼperawatun pentunteran. Ahke irateran, nihpirinwe nuya kankimaran. Nuya kankanterawe kemamare, waʼwawe.

Tananke nani paʼneke, panka werunuʼsa irake akurawate patereʼ. Ku nituhtuwatera unpu ayamantakasu ina weruʼnuʼsa yunireʼ. Inapita aʼnea aʼnea imare. Nuya kankankeran ninanuaʼwanenpu kankimare, mamanenpu ihpumareʼ.
Kemupinewe nimara shaʼwitarawe peʼnate ninanuaʼwa paʼmawatusu ku ahpira wentarawe.

Sami chinpi kepake piyapiʼsa naʼwerapisu aʼnuteke paʼanaimare. Maʼsha ku peike nuwanteresumare ama aʼpatesu. Yamura nahtanteke, ina naʼkun peike paanterinpu. Neʼmehte aʼnutuwachinken niʼke ama nukitu niʼinsu. Naʼkun yunkirawe tahpuna piyapiruʼsa iwarahpirinen, nuya niʼke maʼsharuʼsanen nuyahpiachin nuntuwachinen nuya aʼpanike kemarinta.
¿Unpu inkanputa ina aʼna ninanuke? Irahka muhturuke nani semanke paʼparinwe, ihpurasu tenin ahke irasu ninin.
Uʼmananke ihsu ira yunkirarewa.
¿Kaʼtaintunku mercado pakatewa aʼshatu uskururen paʼantakasu, unpuinsuna irahka ninesu kahpa kankankeran yaʼwereke?
Atari kayumare shapun maʼpateke paʼterinsu nahpupinanchin ninuntuku, ku niawekusu, ni pisan yaʼweresu ku ninuʼwikasu ninin.
Ama teʼwatasuwe, kahpa kankantawa inamare nuya nanan nishaʼwitawa inapuchin uhsharan tahshi naʼwepun.

Shiʼawanen sapuhpirinwe ku yakushatupirinwe, naputerinawe. - Iʼi, ku kahsu weʼerawe, yaʼipi tahshi neʼmehte shipi akuterawe. - nihpirinwe nani nuyaterin, niʼke ina nitewarinsu. - Nuʼten, nahpatun nani nuya kankaterawe, naʼkun naʼnerapirawe.

Yunkirawe tatanewe iterinkusu tanansu manuhtun paʼtuwatera akanuhterinpu. Nahpatun kahsu uhsharan iraterawe kehken peʼpetuwatusu. Nimara kemanta naniteran narakuteke chinuhtamare. Inapuchin nihkatun naniteran chinihken kankantu inkanamare, ku kanuhtukeran nihkamare.
¿Inta muhturu keparin tatamahshu niʼkunpatamasu? Iya mahshunen, irahka puchin yunkirawesu.
Naʼkun ninararanken, nuʼwitupirawe.
Inachachin nuyahkeran kashinuʼsa wayuʼin inaran paʼterinsu chachin pawerechin; inaran nuya kankaeran kehken pe¿peatun uʼmapun.

Unpua iya. ¿Unpuinta iminenke sahkatunen paʼsarin? Nuya kankankeran weʼsarawe pantaʼpinewe aʼnahke kayararinsu paʼanapu weʼsarawe. ¿Nuwanteran ihpura aʼnanun paʼanakasu? Nuya kankankeran nituhtu mahshu ninansu nuntaranke. ¿Yaʼweterinken makesuna peʼpekamare? Nuya akankanteranku nihkatenwe ninanuaʼwake paʼsaransu. ¿Nuwanteran ahketeware ninuntakasu kuʼwara ni paʼantasu?

Wʼkama iyaru yaʼwerekeran. ¿Nuya ahchin tahshi kemanta kemuinenpitare tawerianpiteran? Pantaʼpi iminewekeran kehsarawe paʼanamare. ¿Nuwantumaranke kahtunun ku nihpun karanun ihpura paʼanamare? Nuya kankankeran nuntaranken unpuinsuna mahshuruʼsa aʼchinpisu. ¿Pawantahmarinken uskuru peinenke aʼpetamare? Nuya taweri nihkapun niʼtun nuya kankanterawe. ¿Nanitere piʼpian ninuntakasu kuʼwara ni paʼantasu?

Nunentupaya shaʼwiatun napurin aʼna sanapi irurinkeran ninanuken nininsu ninunenin. Nani tahshiachin tanankeran nunenameruʼsa inpiitawatun uʼwatun inaran imurapirin. Iranta peinenkeran ku pihpirirnwe aʼna uʼnari ashipikamare. Nahpatun aʼnarahchin nuyahterin inapuchin aʼnapitanta shaʼwiterin kañupachinara ninunenkassumare.
¿Unpuatunta muhturuke petehte ninanuaʼke ya paʼninsu? Ahke ira nihpirinwe kehken peʼpetatun iramare paʼnin.
Pisinu ku puʼpian pantaʼpi paʼaninwe.
Peʼpetu kepararawesu kanta kahtawaku, yuhsemare itaraema, ihsu ira ahke nihsarin pinewe kuwachi awanterinwe nahpuin peʼpetarawesu.
Ii yunsanke paʼmawatansu, ku inake kiya nihsaraiwe; nuhsururainkensu kemareʼken paʼsarin yaʼwere kiyahsu ku naniantarainken.

Ku naniterewa tahshi yaʼkuana iʼsuapinan weʼekasumare, kaʼnanuʼsa naniterin kaʼkunkamare nahpatun teʼwachituwe. Maʼsha awiranke iraterinsu nahtanchitu, ku nanichitu pihpikamare naʼkun tatamahshunen naʼwanchitu ina ihpura ku nihsarinwe. Nuya unkutatun waʼwa patuku.
¿Kahtawaitunku mercado nininke pantaʼpi paʼanamare, unpuinsuna irahka waʼwaterewasu puchin inake mamapayasu seʼkerawatunpu ira keparinpua?
Nunshawarinke paʼsawachinsu, ku nuya kankankeran kehparataraiwe; nunansu iʼsha kepararinke yaʼwere kiyahsu nani iʼwaraya ku kenanarainken.
Nanun waʼwawan nininsu ama yaʼihpi iʼkiinsu; unpuinsuna tahpain inaran shapun uskuru paʼanesu kentain.
Nuya yunkiatu ihpurasu maʼsha kapamare peʼpetarawe, ku nituhterawe nimara kansarawe kuʼwara uʼnanasu.
Ku saminewe ya kanpiarawe.
NImara tatamahsu ayunkipun yaʼipinpua sunuanteruʼsa ninanunenpua nihsarinsu tahparapikasu, inake mini yun suʼsurapi akañuinpumare.
Nimara yunupiʼi nihsawasu kankunarawe aʼna ninanuʼawake, nahpatun nuya yunkiatu maʼshanewepita akurarawe inaran iara imahsarawe nihkapu.
Nimara ihsu nunsha nuya yunsake nininke tunpurarawe, nuwantuwatu iʼsha ku nimara aʼnarumara ku ketarinku.

Nani tahshiriamiachin paʼnai pantaʼpi yunihkapui inamare aʼna nara keparai ira aʼnurapikamare. Chiwewatewa, ninanuaʼwake atari perahterinsu nahtanai. Ina nihkatewa nuya kakankeran uruntatewa uʼmarai, inawate ira kenanate peike kankimare.
Ama ahketeware pantaʼpi paʼterinsu aʼpamakesu.

Ku kahsu weʼeitu kuʼwara yuhse nanan nunterawe, ku inaurawe nahpurini tahshi naʼkun teʼwaitu. Chinihken wirahterinke, ku nanichituwe weʼekawasu sehtukeran tawerianpichituwe. Ama niahkenanpikesuwe, amiaʼwa, kaʼtawatunku ku teʼwarawe.
Tahshike iʼshana pentuntarewa.
Ninanukeran uʼmawachin, café yaʼwerinsu niʼin inaran bolsake pan kehsarinsu aʼnea aʼnea yuʼin.
Atarinen mare ina nantiwi nikanpiake nahpupinachin nihkamare; nuya kankantuku nahpupinanchin niketaramasumare.
Iʼwata yaʼipima. Apayarinsu sanapiaʼwari iterin, inaura peinenke nihka waʼyasu chiiinihken uʼnanin.
Ama inake wensekesu, kehken
Kemupiruʼsa shaʼwituku ku waʼkiran uʼmasarawe, kanuhtupikeran weʼsapirawe; iʼshana pama nihsapirinwe nahpatun nunshasu chiniikeran uhsharan paʼnin.

Yaʼwerin taweri nininke wahpurusu piyapikeran nimentarin naʼkun maʼsha puʼmuatuna nimentamiaterin. Kahsu kuʼwianketeranta yunirawe maʼshanewepita peʼtenkamare. Ahke paʼmarare niʼtun napurawe. Nahpatun waʼwa shaʼwitaranke nanituwatan piʼpianteranta weʼehke ama ahketeware kanuhtamare.

kayapi pantaʼpi kepake piyapiʼsa naʼkurapisu paʼanteke. Aʼnarumare iterinensu ama maʼpakesu; uhsharan ninake nuya nunteke. Pahtuma keteke yamuramare inaran kanpu mare tahpake. Sami pihshate ketuwachinara nuya niʼke kuʼwara nuya itasuwe. Ku nimara tuhpinankeran uʼmapun, nuya yunkike ama insharu irake nunpinchinesu.

Nunshakeran pihpiwatui yaʼihpia iʼwata iterai, ku nimara insharu niʼninkui kankiraisu. Maʼshanewepita kehkerinsu yaʼihpia mahsawatui keparai. Ira yunsanke wanitui ninaterai, yunkiatui, nimara peiʼ waʼanenta pihpimarai tehkeinke sami mahkapuna.

Chinihken piʼike iratuwatera aheteware waʼkiterewa. Kahsu wanirawe iʼsha uʼukasumare, iratakasu yunkipirawe. Nimara kema yunkiran awantamare, nihpirinwe kanuhtu inkanterinpu. nahpatun itaranken ku ahkete peʼpetekesu.

Kuʼwara ya weʼehsuwe nu teʼwa shawi nahtanchituwe, inapihkeran ku nanichituwe yaʼpiranewe teʼwakeran tanshikasu. Inapita tahshi shaʼwiterankusu naʼkun taweri nuwanchituwe ama weʼekasumare. Ama aʼpayankusuwe, amiaʼwa, nani payawe nihsarawe.
Tahshira nahkaranchachin piʼi niantapun nahpatun nahkaranchachin yaʼniwitantapun.

Weʼkama iyaru. ¿Nuya kemanta ahchin tahshi weʼeran? Nuya pantaʼpi yaʼweterinkusu ninanuke kehsarawe paʼanakasu. ¿Nuwantahmaran kemuinenpita maʼpatakasu? Nuya kankanewekeran nuntaranken inapuchin mini kemainpusu ninuntere. ¿Kenan nihka kurihki ku nihpun yamurare uskuruke ni pawerekasu? Nuya kankanterawe ihpura tahshiriamichin nininke. ¿Naniteran uhsharan ninuntakasu kuʼwara ni paʼantasuwe?
Nahkaranchachin nuya kankantapun. Paʼsarewa atari kayu yunihkariwa nuya kankantapun karinken peʼperankesumare.

Mahshu nunenaʼpi wiʼnapiruʼsa shaʼwitatun iterin mamapayanenpita chinihken kañukeran chaʼerin. Ina kuʼwara iʼsha uʼusakasu ainpihterin inaran tanan kashinuʼsa paʼmurawatun kaʼne. Nahpatun kunpuru yuʼnamen ikiterin aʼnapitapuchin. Inapita ihpurawanta nuya nihkatewa yaʼwekasumare inapuchin nihkatewa naʼkun piʼi nanpitahrewa.
Nimara nuya kankankeran naʼneitu shaʼwiteranken nahpurini nahpuru waʼwarawa kanpuri maʼparahresu ihpura nani suʼsurin tanan taʼaterin.
¿Ma urapuchin puti ninanuke ya kankirin? Kamuhtechin, ahkeran paʼninkeran waʼwaterinkeran nuwiterinsukeran.

Nuya nihsaran iyaru. ¿Unpuinta ihpura taweri nihsaran? Petehteran uʼmararawe pantaʼpi kayapi kenawe paʼanakamare. ¿Nuwantahmaran aʼnanun ku nihka kahtunun paʼanamare? Nuya kankankeran nuntaranken unpuinsuna yaʼwerekewasu. ¿Nuwantahmaran uskuru peinenke aʼpetamare? Nuya kankanterawe kenanankesumare. ¿Nuya nihka kemamare piʼpian ninuntakamare inaran nihkakasu nipaʼantamare?
¿Tahshiriamichin nimara ninanuke nuya pantaʼpi paʼanakasu, kuʼwara piʼiri ahketeware akayakasu inaran ku insharu ya paʼanpachinpusu?

Nani niketawachinara, inarinkeran paʼteresu inaʼtu aʼnukesu ama piʼpianmare aʼpatesu. Shapun mare inran yamuramare aʼpateke, ina ahpiramiachin nuwantare. Piʼpianmare ama maʼshanen yuʼkesu. Insharu manuhtu nuwantuwachinsu ahkenanpike. Yunkiahrawe tuhpinan ya weʼsahpiranwe ku maʼsha kesahpiranwe nahpatun itaranken ama tahpankesu maʼsha nahtantuwatansu. Nuya nunkatun maʼsha maʼpateke inapuchin nihpatansu nuya paʼsarinke.
Nimara kemuinenpita tehkapuna nuhturuʼsa wekapuna waʼwaruʼsa vacuna nitaimare naʼkun kañuhsapi niʼtun.
Ina ninanukeran wentawachin, panka bolsa nininke aruse tahpain, puʼpina tahpain ihsu semana mare.

Tahshiriamiachin iʼshana pentuntarawe pantaʼpinewe ninanuke paʼankasumare. Chinihken maitarawe chiniirarin niʼtun inaran nani iʼwaraya nihsarin. Aʼshatu paʼaninke pantaʼpi patarawe inakeran paʼanturuʼsa shaʼwitapu. Ina kurihkike sami pihshate paʼanarawe inaran yamura. Puʼpianteranta kurihki kamare tahpapu. Kuʼwara pamatasuwe wentapu.
Ama niwi pantaʼpi aʼpatesu, tata, tahpuna kemareʼken nuʼwitahpirinwe.

Ichiwautunaʼpi apayarinsu ninanuaʼwa yaʼwerinke pakapu tuhpirinwe. Nunshanenkeran paʼsaran itakamare yunkirin, imiranen ankiʼ taʼpawapun. Kahtu iʼsha ni nuwantuwachinara ahke nihpirinawe nichinpitupi aʼna yunsan yaʼweperinawe ina yunkirin itakamare.

Kuʼwara aʼnapitanke iminke ya paʼkasu, panka muhtupi niʼnewa. Chiwewatesu, yaʼpiranenpu ina muhtupi yunireʼ. Inaparihchi iratate ira kenanare. Inapuchin nihkate uruntatun uʼmararan, ku paʼyanatun peike kankimaran.
Kunpuru ku pantaʼpinen aʼnananku.
¿Naʼkunware ya inkanan ina ahke ninanuaʼwake? Iʼi, nani yuhki, nunshake peʼpekawasu kuwachi irahka puchin.
¿Nuya nihka ka kankanchituwe, iyawitanewe nunenawe inaran, niwi askaru maʼpaterawe ina iminewe shaʼterawesu senarahatun pawereʼitenke?
Ku saweniweke naniantarawe.
Ama keʼsha nikanakesu, waʼwa, sahkaikeran iminkeran maneʼ.
Piʼi yamuaninke, aʼnarahchin nunshinanke paʼmake nunsha aʼsunkamare.

¿Unpatansu ku nahtananku ama kemaura tanan yaʼkutekesu, waʼwa? Chihtururi piʼi imutuwachinsu, ¿unpu nituhteran insechita iratamare? Ka wiʼnawiku ninawesu yu imatu chiwerawe nahpatu ku nahpuru uʼmarawe. ¿Ku ya keparan niʼniraʼwanen ina ira nuwiterinsu? Inapuchin, chiwewatansu, ¿ina nanitarin nunshinankeware kepararinken?
Weʼkama, ¿Naniterae karinkenta kahtawakamare ku pawererinensu maʼpakasu?
¿Nuya nihka waʼyanewe kankanchituwe pinshi niwi keterinawe nahpurini, sharuʼsa senarawatu pawerechituwe?

¿Unpanta nihka sehtaransu karinken aʼna nunename tanankeran ketaranken? Kema nuwantuwatansu, amakamare nichinken nuya kankantamare. ¿Nuya irataran iʼshanaʼpakeran kareʼken? Nuya kankankeran kaʼtainken, nuya kankanteke.
¿Nimara mercado waʼanen niwi nimiriu kechitunku, ka nahpuru, nuya kankaeran shiʼshi paʼanawatu pawerechitu?
Ku ninanuaʼwake paʼshatararei

Nunentumahshu yunkiatun napurin aʼna mahshia chinihken iru kankiahpun ni chaʼerinsu. Aʼkayan chinihken sewen nihsawasu sawanasake ni imuterin inaran uʼnanapachinsu ku yuʼnatapun pihpirinwe. Inaran tanan nunenameruʼsa aʼitawatun uʼurin. Nahpatun nahpuru tawerike ku irusahsuwe taweri naʼwerin, inapuchin aʼnapita tatamahshuruʼsa nihkatuna ku iru kañuhtapuna.
Ku nantupinewe keparahtarawe.

¿Naniteran tataparin nahtankamare wahpuru kankipu? Ahketeware nimara ihpura waʼkipun. Naʼkun piyapiruʼsa ninaramara. Muhturu nahtanaresu aʼna nunsha nihsamara. Unpuinta yunkiran shaʼwituku, kuwachi nituhterawe.
Kepakamare ahketeware keʼsha nimara anpipu, tahpuna aʼna ninanuke kanpatu tanarahpirawe inake kapakamare.
Imiranewe chinihken seʼkeku, yuhsemare, ahke iraterawekeran nansewe ikiterawe; paʼmakasuihchin yunkirawe peen yaʼkaria chinuhtakasu.
Kuʼwara tahshisawasu uʼmantakasu nuwanterai, ahke itarereke peike kansarewa nihpirinwe nantenenpua nani kanuhterin.
Unpua, waʼwanewe. Iʼwara teʼnai iʼshanaruʼsa pentunteran. Aʼna kehken kuhtaru peʼperan, nihpirinwe chinihken nuya kankantun uʼmaran. ¡Ma nuya kenanankesu!

Kareʼken ninateke, ku nuwanterawe kaura iiyunsanke nihkawasu. Ku nimara wahpuru ihpra kankipu tahshinantarin niʼtun. ¿Kema nituhteran ma urata naʼwerin? Kahsu ku yunkirawe. Nimara iʼwaraya wekapun. Maʼsha ahke nahtanpatan shaʼwituku, yuhsemare, nituhtawasu.
Ahketeware chinii yaʼweterinku nahpurini, iminanke paʼituwe shaʼwitamare unpu kahtawarankuta; ina yunkiatu nuya kakanterawe inaran sehtumiachin kankanterawe.
Ama ahketeware ina sanapi keʼsharuʼmu niwi ketekesu, iʼwa keteresu ku ayanterinpu.
Wankana puchin nani iratate ikanpatera, paʼa wensate iʼsha nukuitawa, inapuchin mamanewe ninin kuʼwara pakasuwe.
Aʼna piyapi nahpurini ku nihka aʼnaruahchin weʼitun nahpuru tahshi kahtawatamare; nahpatun, taweriruʼsa naʼweperiun, kahsu yusparinken itaranken.
Waʼwa, kanuhtu mahpachinpusu naniterewa iʼshana yunsanke chinuhtakasu, inapuchin yunkiʼitu waʼwatapu tatamahsunen peʼperinkusu.
Nani senarawekeran pihkeran kahsu ninanuke paʼmarawe piʼshi inaran nawan paʼanamare. Kaʼtanku, waʼwa, kuʼwara tahshiwasu paʼmarewa.

Tanan paʼtewatera, panka nararuʼsa nihkatewa paʼne ku chiwekamare. Ahke ira nihpachinsu, naraseʼparaʼwaruʼsa seʼpanawate patereʼ. Inapuchin, ayantumatera, nuʼten ira imate kahpa kankankeran kuʼwara tahshiyasu peike kankimare.

Ku kahsu ahketeware tahshirinke vecino yaʼwerinke ku paʼituwe, ku naraiteʼ tahshinanke kenanchituwe. Tahshinanke anuterawe nahpurini ku insharu uu tenawesu ku insharu nahtainkusu nahpatun sehteitu. Ku chinii yaʼwechitunwe kemaura uʼmakamare, nahpatun shaʼwichitenwe.

¿Nahpuru taweri tata iineʼ yunkipi nahpuinanchin peʼpete niketatuna peʼpekaimare? Nahpuatuna nahpuinachin mercado ninike kankunpi irahkapuchin. ¿Ku nihka yunkiran nahpuru unputa panka nunun pantaʼpi aʼpaterewa? Ku naʼkun aʼpaterewa nihpirinwe yamura peinenpumare inkanpirinwe. ¿Nahkaranchachin inapuchin taweri yaʼwapun nihka inake yaʼipinpua nunshake nuya kankankeran ninanuke paʼmakemare?

Ku tuhpinankeran yunsanke wensatun wahpuru ninataransu. peʼnahte wesewatansu maʼshanenpita ashipitaran. Ama nunshanen ku tunpupinan patekesu inaputuwatansu ku peike nanitapun wentamare. Ama ahkenanpikesu nunshinanen, wahpuru ku ninararinken. Nuya niʼsake, waʼwa, ama maʼsha paʼnanke unpukesuwe.
Iʼsha yunsanke nimara kahsu ninatarawe pamaterinsu winkinawitamare, ku ahkete nanitapu pentuntakasu nani semana niterawepuchin.
Piʼpianteranta chinuhchi, ahke iraterawe yunanuwe nani kanuhterin; peike ya oaʼnawe kuʼwara uʼnatasuwe.
Tahshiraya paʼpatan, kuwachi imine ni kenanareʼ; naʼneiru yaʼpira nimara yaʼwetarinkui ku nikenanewa niʼtun.

Ku shaʼwiterinaku sanapiraʼwa narakeran anuterinsu, ihpurawe nituhtarawe. -naʼkun sehtupirai, ku ahkete nituhtupirai. - Tuhpinan niawerinsura tuhpi. - Ihpura nuya nitewakasu, nahpuru taweri naʼkun sehtupirawe.
¡Weʼkama! Ahke irateran kahtu pankai iʼshanaruʼsa pentunteran. Kehken muchiranen nihpirinwe, nuya kankankeran kankiantaran. Nuya kankanterawe kemamare ihseke nihsaransumare.

Ihpura pantaʼpi ninanu yunsanke paʼanarawe. Tata kahtu nunun pantaʼpi ketarinku kepakamare. Manunhtu iratarawe naʼkun piyapi yaʼwerin ya paʼanpisu. Samimare pantaʼpi aʼpatarawe vecino iikeran kentarinsu. Inawatu kusharu peike kepararawe inaran kurihki yaʼwerinsu tahpararawe. Manuhtu weʼsarawe iminke kahtatamare.
Kuʼwara nipatasuwe, aʼna maʼsha shaʼwichinken: inute nihsarinken chinihken piʼi nihsarinsu chinpiraran inake puʼpianteranta chinuhtaran.
Ku yaʼwapun panka tanan yunkirainkensu imutakasu; kemaura paʼsaran, naʼneiru yaʼpira paʼsaran ni itaresu ku sehturukeran nihkapun.
¿Nuwanteran ihpura pawererapisu kari tahpawasumare?
Aʼshin ku inaura waʼwin tananke aʼpararinwe, inare paʼsarin nani iraterinke aʼpayakasu.
Kema naʼkun nuhsurarankuisu ku unpuranta chiminarinwe; paʼpatansu ku pihta nihsaraiwe, tuhpinan pahkariu ira kepararinke.

Ku ahkete tahshirarinke nanparin iʼchinpichituwe, iwani atahkuichitun nahpatun kahsu teʼwarukeran kehparichituwe. Tahshisu waʼkirinke ku yaʼwechitu ineta nuntakamare nahpatu amiaʼwaruʼsa tewapisu yunkiitu. Ku kaura nanichituwe nihkamare.

Ahchin tahshi ku nuya weʼehterawe wiʼnawe yunkiatu tananke paninkeran ku uʼmapirinwe. - nuya kankanteke, nani tahshiriamiachin winarinkeran kankirin - ¡Ma nuya kankanterawe! naʼkun paʼyanpirawe, sehterawekeran ku manta kaʼnawe.

Tata, ¿unpatunta mercado ku mahkira piʼpian aʼpatate paʼanewa? Karinken iminke kahtawaranken yuntunkamare. ¿Piyapiruʼsa ku yapaʼanpi ku nihka niwi nahtantupi? Shaʼwituku tataraʼwa, ¿nahkaranchachin kehken peʼpetate paʼsarewa?
Nantupi pantaʼpire ninanuʼpa kepatuku, yuhsemare. Arusemare kanpiarawe, inaran nahpupinachin iʼsha imarawarui uʼmarai.
¿Nishirapirararewa unputa paʼanarewa inaran unputa maʼshake iʼkirarewa, ku nihka nahkaranchachin peike paʼmarewa ku nihtuhtatewa unputa kanarewa ku nihka niwiterewa?
¿Unpuatunta nihka sanapisu waʼwin peʼpeatun uhsharan ayaatun keparin? Waʼwin nuyahsha peʼperankeran weʼehkamare nuninsu nahtanawatun. ¿Naʼkun waʼwin nuhsusurin niʼtun nahpatun kahpa kankanterin?

Mamaraʼwa, ¿maʼta iʼwa mercado keparewa paʼankamare, atariruʼsa ku nihka kayunen? Kahsu iratereke kanuhterawe. ¿Yaʼipi keparesu paʼane? Uhshahkeran shaʼwituku, ¿inkanin kurihki aʼmukasu paʼantarankusu iterankusu?
¡Manuhteke paʼa! Ninanuke kahsu atarinewe ya paʼanawe nahpatun naʼkun yamura ya kenawe. kehke nantupinen yaʼipi peʼpekamare.

Nunentunaʼpi shaʼwiatun napurin aʼna wiʼnapi nantenenke taʼtarapiriun ninuneninsu. Ina nani taweri tanan werun aʼyutawatun ni paʼmurin. Inaranta ninin ina taʼta nanitaweri maʼshake tunpurawatun niterin. Aahpatun aʼnarumara nuhsanen nimanin, nahpatun ina waʼwasha, ihpura nipayarinsupita shaʼwiatun iterin naʼkun inaura ni nuhsuruatun nuyahterin.

Uhshiwarinke wairinkeran ku maʼshateranta kaʼninwe, naʼkun sehtupirawe. - Iʼira, ku wensekasumare nanitupirawe. - Nihpiirnwe ihpura nani nuya ninawe, waʼwin ashuʼshurarin. - Yusparinken kema ku inaura pateranwe.
Nimara wini shiʼshi ahpi ketapuna.
Iʼwata ahpi, ¿naniterawe itakamare tahshiraya nihka yaʼihpi nihka pawereapuna?
Shapun nipisan yaʼweresu kepateke inake paʼterinsu aʼpateke nahpupinachin nuya nihkaimare, inapuchin nihkayuma nuya kankantarama.

¿Kema tenan wahpuru kuʼwara yunutahshi kankipun? Nimara ahke nihsamara. Nuya niʼke tehkein shaʼwituku kenanpatansu. Ku nimara ihpura wekapun. Nimara ahketeware piyapiruʼsa ninaramara. ¿naniteran nahkaranchachin niʼke kamare, yuhsemare?

¿Yunliran nahpuru panake wenseate aʼna shaʼwi shaʼwiteranken, waʼwa? Aʼna waʼwasha ku shaʼwipinan pakatun maiterin, ¿unpurinta anpuke pakatun chiwewachinsu? Ihpurawanta kahsu sehterawe aʼshin yunirinsu. ¿Insekesuna paʼpatansu kema shaʼwike? Chiwepantansu, ¿nanitapuna pakatuna kenankaimare?
¡Kahtenpu ninanuʼpa paʼa! Sami pantaʼpi ya kenawe. Kahtawaku nantipinewe kahtawaku, puʼpian karinken ketaranken.

Ihsu semana panka ninanuke paʼnawe nimiriuruʼsa paʼankamare. Yaʼipima ni nuhkumaku tahshi ama naninatukusu yaʼkuana unkutamare. Chinihken uʼnanpachinsu, ama iʼshana pentuitukusu, ninanku amasha pama nihsarinsu paʼmakamare. Ku waʼkiran uʼmantararawe nahpuinchachin peike niantamare.
Ihpura tahshi tatamahshuruʼsa akahpa kankantawa, ama patawasu teʼwapike.

¿Kuʼna nihka tatasu nani taweri wiʼnin yunkirin ahke paninsu nituhtamare? Yuʼnatapun paʼpachinasu, ¿kuʼna shaʼwirin unpu nihkatuna nanpipi? Nipayapisupita nuya nanan nuntawatuna a kahpa kankanpi, ¿nuʼten? ¿Nuya ninin ina nuya kankankeran yaʼwatun winin ninakamare? Nunshasu kahparike paʼnin, ¿Ku winarinwe ni kenanwachina nahkeranchachin?
Penuntu nimara itarinpu kanpurachachin ninuhkumakasu ama inapihkeran kañukamare.

Wʼkama iyaru. ¿Nuya kemanta nihsaran? Petehtekeran kankimararawe nunsha mentahshin pantapi kemararawe. ¿Waʼwaruʼsa marenen ya paʼanahmaran? Nuya kankankeran nuntaranken unpuinsuna kanpua yaʼweresu. ¿Unpu nununta ihpura nuwantaran? Paʼantuwatanku, aʼna uskuru ketaranken aʼpetamare. ¿Ku akahpaninke nuyawan ihpura nihsarinke?

Tahshiraya tahshiachin peʼperawatun ninanuke pasarawe pantaʼpinewe paʼanamare. Manutarawe kuʼwara taweriari nunsha pihpiarin. Kara nunun panka pantaʼpi kepararawe aʼshatu paʼaninke patarawe. Kurihki manaweke mama kantinake niwiterinke paweretapu. Ku waʼkiarawe, kuʼwara uʼnanasuwe uʼmantararawe.
Ihpura aʼpetawa peinenpu akahpa kankantakasu tahshiru kankiwachinsu.
Waʼwa, nantupinen iʼshanapaware ka peʼperarawe, inake chinuhtereke shaʼwitaranken waʼwateraweke unpu ninaweta.
Ninanukeran uʼmawatu, yamura inaran fideos ya kenawe. Ihsu bolsa kepatuku, kehkeninsu ka peʼpearawe, ¡manuhtu peike paʼa!

Ku kahsu yaʼipi tahshi tanan nahtanchinan ku kehparichituwe, teʼwarawesu ku tawerinenke nanichutuwe kushatamare. Niʼniruʼsa naʼkun nunkarupi, kankanewe nuya kankanchituwe. Ku inapuchin ya yaʼwerawe, teʼwakeran yaʼweitu.

¿Naniteran ihsu bolso nituku kahshu tehkein niʼsarawe? Nimara ahkeran wahpuru weʼsamara nahpatun ku kankirinwe. Nimara ku nuya niʼsarawe. Naʼkun waʼkirarin peʼpetun kehsamara.Kema shaʼwituku nahtanwatansu, yuhsemare.
kanuhtu nihsawatansu, wankana ira nihsawasu chinuhtariwa. Panka nara yamuaninke wenserarewa inaran nahkaranchachin mairarewa petehte iminke iminkeʼpaware.
Tanan aʼshin shaʼwiterai kahtawainpusu nuya nihkatui iʼwaraya peike inkanakasu, chinii nihsarin niʼtun ina aiʼwatarinpua.

¿Kuʼna nihka ina nani taweri yuʼyunen shaʼwiriarin peʼnate paʼmarinsu? Ina nani iʼwaria nihpachinsu. ¿Kuʼna ina maʼsha ku irinenke nihkatun inake nuya kankaeran yunkirin? Yaihpia ninanuke yaʼwepisu nuya nanan nuntatunan akahpa kankanpi, ¿nuʼten? ¿Ku nihka nuya ina nani tahshiachiachin nuya kankanchin yunkiatun uʼmantararinsu? Tatamahshu tenin kankanewenpu uhsharan nuyahterin, ¿nuʼten? ¿Kuʼna nuyahpiachin ninin nuhsururesu ninakasu?
¿Ku mercado pantaʼpi paʼanan?
Nani iʼwaraya iminkeran uʼmaransu, kuʼwara nanpetakasu piʼpianteranta chinuhteke, inapuchin nihkatun ku ahkete kanuhtaran.
¿Nuya kankachitu nimara kema nimiriu keteranku inapihkeran pawereitun, pantaʼpi paʼanawatun pawereiyunke.
Nimara ni ketapun nunshanen aʼna niti mare.
Iʼsha irininsu nahtanke inaran iiyunsake nininsu parichi irateke.
Ku yaʼipi ahkemare pakamare peʼperawe.

Nani tahshiwasuwe ku kahsu pihpiitu, kuwachi tahshinanke kenanchituwe naʼkun teʼwa maitunku. Tananke chiwerawe nahpurini, ku imin kenaitu naʼkun peinewe sehtechitu. Ku nuya kaura pakakasu inamare aʼna ninterina kepakasu.

¿Nituhteran unpuatunta nani taweri ina narakechachin nunshanewe tunpurawe, waʼwa? peʼirankeran uʼmawatansu, ¿nunshinanen nuwiteran? Irahka kahsu ku nuwitatu ahke maitatu paʼnawe, paʼpi ahke nininke. ¿Tahshi nihsawasu ku nunshinanen niʼpatansu ku tewaran? Nahpatun nahtananke: ¿niteran ihpurasu nunshiwaninen, ihpurawanta karinsu kahtawararainken?
Ku ihpura paʼanamare kahtawararanke, mamapaya, aʼna kañaʼpi nunenarawe.
Nani kanuhtawatansu, ku manuhtu maitaranwe. Yamuaninke yunitu inake chinuhtaran amasha chinii yaʼwetamare.
Niʼsaran mampayanen manuhtun ninunenarin. Ku ahkete naʼneraran wachi, nani nuyahtuwachinsu nanitaran ihpuahtamare.
Niwiteresu tienda nininke pawerechin, inapihkeran nahsha yuʼnanan paʼanararin nahpatun nuya kankaeran uʼmapun.

Tataraʼwa, ¿ihsu tuminku taweri maʼta senate mercado kepararewa, shihpi ku nihpun uhkunaʼpi? Ka nanpeatu kahtawaranken. ¿Naʼkun paʼanterinenpu ku nihka kashin kayaru yaʼsurin? Shawituku tata, ¿Naniterewa fideos askaru ku ahkete paʼterinsu paʼanate kemupinenpua kapaimare?
¿Nantupinen aʼnaintunku mercadi nininke pantaʼpi paʼanamare, yunkiatu tatamahshunewe irahka ii shaʼwi shaʼwiterinkusu?

Tanan kashinuʼsa kayahshin niihsapisu piyapiruʼsa paʼanteke inaran shapun mare kanpiake. Maʼsha chanatun nahpunin nininsu kanpuamare ama maʼpatekesu. Nuya niʼke kuʼwara maʼpatasuwe. Kenanpatansu piʼpianteranta yamura maʼpateke. Nimara yunkiahrawe tahpuna ku ahkete maʼsha ya maʼpatahpiranwe. Nuya niʼke maʼpataransu uhsharan pake ama naniantesu ihseke waʼwaruʼsa ninararinen.
Inapita sanapiruʼsa niyuntunatuna kurihki yuntuina nunsha paʼanaimare.
Yaʼkuana nuya unkutawa ku waʼwaruʼsa tahshike patakasu.
Iyareʼken nani tahshiwachinar uʼmake, inapuchin ni kaʼtanawatuna uʼmarama inapuchin nihkatuma ira ahke nininsu nuya kankirarama.

Iʼwara tuʼnaru ninesu inanta piyapiruʼsa aʼnuteke yamuramare shapumare paʼanke. Yaʼipi nantupi ama yuhkesu; kanpumare ihsu semana mare kapamare akuke. Piyapiruʼsa ku ahkemare nuwantuwachinara puipian aʼpateke. Tewarawe ku maʼsha kehparitapun kapamare. Nuya nihkatun piyapiʼsa nunteke Inapuchin nihkatewa piyapiruʼsa nuya maʼsha yaʼweterinpusu inapita iminenpura yaʼwerinsu paʼantarinpua.
¿Pantaʼpimare nanietere uskuru inaran yamura maʼpatakasu, ku nihka kurihkirahchin maʼpatarewa innuke paʼanpatera?
Ina ku ahkete sami yuhkapun puʼpishara yamuramare. Inamare ku nihka nuyawe, nahapatun mercado nininke kepararin kuirhkimare paʼanamare. Ku ahkete pantaʼpi yaʼwetatun, ina piyapire ku niketapuna.

Unpuinta nihsaran iyaru. ¿Ihsu semanake nuya kemuinenpita nihsapi? Iminewekeran uʼmararawe pantaʼpi peʼperawekeran kehsarawe. ¿Nuwanteran paʼanamare ku ahkete paʼterinwe? Nuya kankankeran nahtanaranken unpuinsuna tatamahsunewe aʼchinterinkusu. ¿Nuwantahmaran uskuru aʼpetamare? Nuya kankanterawe naʼa nuya piyapiʼsa plazake nihsapi niʼtun. ¿Nuwanteran ninuntamare kuʼwara nipaʼankasu?

Ku ahkete peʼpetu paʼanaran inapihkeran ku nanitaran wahpuruke yaʼkunamare. Piyapiruʼsa nunkapuna ku yaʼwepachinsu insekesuna akukamare nahpatun ku nuwantapuna maʼpainkesuna kepararansu. Ku nunshanen akunetatun patakamare piyapiruʼsa yaʼkuyapun. Ku muhturu kamayu nuʼwiaran inamare ku aʼnarumare kepararinken. Taʼcharawatun ninake inawatan nuya pihpitarinken, iyaru.
Mama pawerechin tumamare inaran ka yamura paʼanarawe; inapuchin kahpa kankantu peinenke uʼmararan.

Mama shaʼwiterawe yaʼipinpua nunshake paʼsarewasu. Ama aʼpetawatun kuhsina pihpinanpikesu. Niʼniraruʼsa aʼkake inaran iʼwaraya nihsawatun chinuhteke. Ahketeranken kankinpatu utehsawatu shaʼwitaranken.

Peʼyawatapun ya paʼpatera, niʼnewa inseranta piʼi pihpirin. Ahke nani iratuwatera ku inkanpatera, pankai iʼshana yunirewa. Ina imate inkanarewa. Inawate nuya kankankeran inkanare, kemuinenpita samiruʼsa kepatarewa.
¿Sanapi waʼwin mamapayanenke weʼewatuwachinsu aʼshin naʼkun nuwanin? Ina tenin peinen tanawanterin waʼwin ku inake tewarinsu nihpachinara. ¿Yunkimara ina sanapi waʼwin ku waʼkirinwe?
Tata wiʼnin paʼninsu pihkeran ku inaura kehparitapun, winatun kahpa kankankeran wiʼnin wentapun ina nituhterin.
Ku inkaniwe yaʼipi paʼnakasu.
¿Nuwanteran pantaʼpi mercado nininke peʼpeatu kepakamare? Irahka iyaweruʼku kahpa kankaeran peʼperawatui ira taʼaterai.

Suʼyawe peʼyawateran ku wentarinwe nahpatun naʼkun yunkipirawe. - ¿unpurinta inapihkeran? - nunsha nuhkuantupirinwe, nahpatun yunikeran kankunin. - Ku tewarawe nahpuru, nihpirirnwe nani nihkatu nuya kankanterawe.
Ama nantipi piʼpian aʼpatesu, waʼwa, sahkaikeran tiniran.

Aʼna semana ku wiʼnawepita niʼnawe, ku nuya weʼehpirawe. -¿Ahke nisahpirinawe? - Iʼiura, iʼshana imiʼpa, ku nanitupiwe shaʼwitaimare. - kankiwachinara aʼna naʼnei yaʼpiranewe pihpiterinku. Ihpurasu nuya kankanterawe, yaʼipichchin peinewe nihsapi.
Kahpa kankankeran uruntawa ama teʼwatamare maʼsha tananke nahtanpatera.

Naʼkun taweri mare nipayarinsu tananke pakapun. Ii yunsankeʼpaware kaʼtanapuna awaitukamayu yunkipiriun inake wachi imirakeran paʼsarawe itapuna. Inakeran wachi inaura peinenke pakapun yunkipirinwe, ku sehterinkeran, nuya kankantu tahshiriamiachin kahtawaterinsu.
Quema ku kahtawaranku nahpurini ahketeware yunkiʼitu, kaura ku ihsu sanapi kanuhterinsu ku nanichitu peʼpekamare.
Nimara nuya nihka kankanchitu ayanteranke yaʼipi kema kahtawarankusu nahpuru taweri nunenameruʼsa kepatu pentunawesu.

¿Unpuinta nihka ina sanapi kankanterin waʼwin nani taweri nihkatun suʼsurarinsu? Ina yunkirin waʼwin chinihken nihkatun suʼsuapun. ¿Yunkirin nihka insa waʼwiawanen suʼsupachinsu nitu yuʼnatapun inaran iminke sahkatapun?
¿Uhshiraʼwa paʼankamare kemari paʼankamare kahtaʼwaitun? Puʼpiraʼwa inasu paʼaintun, inapuchin kanta mercado pakatu kañariterawe.
Tahshira nuya nihsaran, nuya kankataran niʼniraʼwamare. Aʼna niʼniraʼwa nahpuinachin yunihsarewa inawachi iminke paʼnanke imahsarinke.
Ama ihpura pakesu
Nuya kankankeran yunkirai uhsharan tahshike pakakasu, nunshasu nuya nimentarin waʼwarawasu peike nuwanterin chinuhtakasu.
¿Tahshiachin nihka nunshake pihpirarewa, ku nihka aʼnapita piyapiruʼsa ninararewa niyuntunkamare kanpuanta pantaʼpinenpua paʼanakasu?
Ina wiʼnapi kurihkine tahpain ama irake tuhpinamare iʼkiinsu.
¿Nuhsururanke aʼshicha, naniterawe nihka ihsu keʼsha inapihkern pawerekamre ketakasu?
Ama iya manuhtun maikesu
Ku inapichin ina paʼterinwe, waʼwa, ama paʼankesu.
¿Nuya yunkiaʼwa makesuna iʼkirarewa pantaʼpi paʼanate kanarewasu, ku nihka maʼshake ku nuwanteresu paʼanate ikirarewa?

Tatamahshunen feria nihsarinke peyaranen aʼnupachinsu, waʼwa, kemari wanipake. Kemari kurihki ketupisu kahtawake pichitamasu. Irahka tatanewe inapuchin niterawe, ihpurawanta kanuhtu nunterinsu yunkirawe.
Ku kemaura nihsaran, waʼwa. Karinken niʼsaranken tatasu tehkeinken sami mahsarin, nuya kankantaputan sami kentawachinsu.
Ina kemapi wiʼniawanen nuhsururinsu ku tananpitarinwe, nuya kankaeran nuhtapun ku inaura patarinwe naʼnekamare.

¿Kuʼna nihka nahpuru taweri yaʼipichachin yunkipi peʼkeran pihpikaimare panka mercado pakaimare? Irahka tataruʼsa pantaʼpinen yuntunatuna taʼcharawatuna iʼsha kepatupi. ¿Kuʼna nihka yunkiran inake nuya ninuntatuna pantaʼpi aʼpataimare yunkipi? Inake ku insharu vecino nunpiterinwe. ¿Wenantapun nihka inapuchi taweri nahpuru kemapiruʼsa inapuchin ninuntupisu, inaran yaʼipichachin yamura wiʼninpitare niketupisu?

Yaʼipia nuntawatui kankunai, nimara piyapiʼsasu aʼna parihchi nihsapirinawe. Nitiruʼsa sami manesu panka peikeware peʼperawatui keparai, ku nituhterai peiʼ weʼewatakasu yaʼwemara. Ku nuya kankanterai nani tawerisu naʼkurawachinsu kiyahsu ninanuaʼwa waʼan nuntamare ninararaisu.
Ku kaura paʼituwe iʼsha tahshinanke yunihkamare. Tahshinanke iʼpaitu, ku insharu kahtawaitunku sehtu kankanchituwe. Ku aʼnaruahchin waniitu, nahpatun nuwanterawe tehkeinpake kaʼtankamare.

Kuʼwara waʼwaruʼsa kahpayatasu ka pihpirawe. Nuya aʼpayaku imin ama kaʼnanuʼsa yaʼkunatuna shiʼshi kaʼinasu. Iʼshanakeran iʼsha urinankeruʼsa mentahtuku yunupiʼi nihsawasu chinuhtuku. Ku waʼkiasu kankirarawe inake pihta nihkariwa.

Sanapi shapun paʼaninsu atari kayu aʼnuteke. Shapumare kanpiake ama ahketeware ketekesu. Yunkike shapunsu puʼpian taweri newerinpua waʼwaruʼsa kañuhpi ku nuya paʼmuwatera. Ku maʼshanenpua tuhpina niketeke, maʼshamare kanpiake. nahpunin kankanterawe naʼkun maʼsha pawanterinpu, nahpatun itaranken nuwantereresu maʼpateke peike kehkamare ama maʼsha tuhpinan peike yaʼwekamare.
Unpua, nuhsuru wiʼnawe. Teʼnai iʼshanaruʼsa pentunteran shipishipi uʼmaran. Ahke irateran, nihpirinwe uruntatun kankiran. ¡Ma nuyata kankanterawe niʼsarankesumare!
Yuhse iterai kahtawakui kiyanta ihsu iʼwarea peike kankuntakasu, sanapi waʼwine nininsu kaʼtanai niʼtun.
Kema ku ihseke samiwarin paʼanan.

Iʼsha ahkekeran ichiwaitunaʼpi nipayarinsu pakapun nituhtamare tenin. Chinihken ihpurarawe tenin ichiwaitunaʼpi inaranta itapun ninanuaʼwanen ama nannianchinsu. Taweri paʼninsura nituhterin niahketakasu yunkirin, ni nuhsurupisu chihken panka nara puchin nahkapun.

¿Kuʼna nihka tata saʼine nani yuhkiwan nihsarinke mercado kepakaisu? Inapita pantaʼpi peʼpepi, keʼsha inaran pihshate yamurare niketamare. ¿Nahpuru kemupinenpua nanan ni ketuwatera nahterewa? A¿pateresu inachachin yaʼipi aʼpatupi. ¿Inseketa kehpariterin nahpuru taweri tatamahshu kuʼwara pakasuwe nunsha apenuirinsu, inake iiwaʼyan nahtanin nuya iʼshake kepaisumare?
Atari kayunen keʼshare niketaʼ, inairawe ninanuke ka. Kehke nantupinen paʼa nahpuinachin iʼshanaʼpa.

Ku ninanukeran pihpiaran kuʼwara shaʼwitu wahpuru ninataransu. Ku insharu nituhtuwachinsu inseke nihsaransu, ku nanitarai iʼwatuwantansu yunihkaimare. Nunsha ku aʼnantupinan ku nuʼsurate yaʼwetuwachinsu ama yaʼkunkesuwe, ku nanitaran pakamare, ku aʼnarumare nunshake ya yaʼkunkesu ya tuʼkuwituhpiran. Nahpatun ninateke.
¿Unpuatunta yunkiraran ihsu tahshi uʼnananinsu? Kema nuwantuawatansu kehparitarawe uʼnan naʼwekawasu. Ka wenu awaichitu kahtenpu uʼukamare. ¿Ku nihka nuya kankanchitun ihse kaʼtanankesu?

¿Kuʼna nihka ina ku nuyawe iyakapini niyuntunatuna yunkipi kuʼwara paʼanaisu maʼsha niketakaisumare? Nahpatun mini tatasu nani taweri pantaʼpi peʼperawatun mercado keparin. ¿Yunkiran kema naʼkun aʼpaire unpu aʼpatakasu ku ahkeran tuhpinankeran pakakasu? Ina paʼanawate aʼna yuhkimare yamura paʼanewa. ¿Yaʼwantapun nihka inapuchin taweri inamini nahpuinachin iratereke tatamahshunenpu aʼchinterinpusu yunkiresu?

Yunkirawe irahka ahke iminke inkanakasu waʼwatahpu kanuhtu inkanawe. Tatanewe maʼsha kehkeninsu peʼpetawatun keparin kahsu tuhpina imarawe. Nahpatun ihpura yunkirawe inanta irahka kanuhterin. nahpatun itaranken ama tahpankesu chinuhtamare nahtantuwatansu.
¿Unpuin nihka kahpa kankanchituwe niwi ya¿pirinuʼsa keteranku nahpurini, karinken pawereʼitunke aresenewe paʼanaweke?
Tata, tanawatewasu yamuaninke wensatewa pantaʼpi kaʼa. Kema nahkaranchachin peʼpeantaitunku unpuinsuna irahka waʼwatapu.
Uʼmawachin, nuyahpiachin neʼmehtere nininsu ninanukeran kentararinsu vecina aʼnuchin.
Ina piyapi nuyakeran shiʼshi kepain mercado paʼanamare.
Nunsha kehken nihsarin naʼkun pantaʼpi puʼmupi niʼtun. Nani wankanapuchin ya kankunasu iiyunsanke chinpiatun tunpuraran inake chinuhtariwa amasha chinii yaʼwetainpusumare.

¿Unpuatunta nihka sanapisu waʼwin nuya kankankeran keʼsha kaʼpachinara niʼninsu? Ina tenin maʼsha waʼwin nihpachinara ina nihkatun kahpa kankanterin. ¿Kuʼna nihka nani sanapi nuya kankanterin waʼwin peinenke nihkatun?

Yamura shipikeran ku sami kechutuwe, inasu ku maʼmareteranta paʼterinwe. Ina paʼanaʼpi ku makenwe paʼtapun tenin, paʼanpike taweri ninatapun tenin. Ku nuya yamura yaʼwepachinsu ku aʼna ninanuke kepapun.
Weʼkama kemupinewe. Mamapayasu amin iminke inaura kenanawatun uʼnan pihkeran kehparaterinsu nunterin, nuya nuntawatun maʼsha inpiitawatun keterin uʼukamare.
Kehke keʼshawarin pantaʼpirewe nikanpiawa, paʼa sanawinpu kapini niketawa irahkakeraware ninesu puchin iminkeran wentawatera.
Nuʼwituwatu, inapihkeran ihpuinken.
Inapita ku sami ketapuna irahka yamuramare, inasu kuwachi nuyawe maʼsha pihshatamare. Paʼanaʼpis tenin ina ku nuwanterinwe, mercado kepapun nuya pantaʼpi niketamare. Inapuchin nihkamare yunkirirn.
¿Unpuruta ina iʼshana pentunterin? tahshiriamichin, chinihken muhturu irinpachinsu inake ahke iʼshana nininke waʼwaterinsu puchin.
Iiwaʼyan shaʼwiterai nahpuru iʼwaraya kahtaʼwainpua nuya nihkatui peike inkanakasu. ahke iminkeran paʼnai niʼtun.
Ku aʼnarahchin ninanke inkanewe
¿Nuya nihka kankanchituwe niwi keterinawe aʼna nahsha weʼehta, ka nuyakankachituwe, pawereʼitenke atari paʼanaweke?

Nunentusanapi shaʼwiatun napurin aʼna sanapi waʼwin chiʼchikañukeran waʼwin iʼwa piʼihpike nininke achaʼehterin. Inasu tuhpinan shuʼshunen ketatun inaran ya peʼpewachinsu imiranen nipaʼmurin. Sanichuruhsa weʼpachinara kepatun ni pahkunarin. Inapuchin ina sanapi aʼnapita sanapiruʼsa shaʼwiterin inapuchin nihkatuna waʼwinaʼwaruʼsa chinihken nihkatuna suʼsuapuna.
Naʼnei inkiwatansu panka sami manawesu ketaranken. Niʼsaran kuwachi naʼneraran kahpa kankantapun.
Waitu kamayureʼken pawere maʼpakamare nuya yunkiku: nimara sami nanpiru maʼpatuku, shapun nihka nuya anta, inamare yusparinke tehke.

Ama saʼan inaura iiyunsanke tahshi wahpuru ninakamare patekesu. Sewenatun ku nanitapun weʼehkamare inaran yun ku nuyawe nitapuna. Ama naniantekesu shihpite inaran sawanasa kepamare. Ama nunshane ahke kepatun tunpukesu, inautuwatansu tahshiraya ku kenanaransu. Nahteku, iyaru, ku nuwanterawe kañukamarewe.

Weʼkama tenai ii yunsanke kankunpatera, nimara iwan iʼsha nunesu kepatupirinkui. Wanirankeran maʼsharuʼsa keparaisu mahkatui ninaterai. Sami nanpiru peʼperai kemupiruʼsamaremare, nihpirinwe ku nuyawe kankanterai ku peinewe kenankunai.

Nahpatun yunkirawe wahpurusu naʼkun waʼkirin nunshinanke kankunamare. Ahke paʼne yunsan nihkatu kanpusu kanuhterewa. Kahsu iʼsha inaran pantaʼpi aʼnira keparawe tuhpinanteranta. Inapuchin kemanta naniteran wiʼnawe nihkamare ku napunin iratamare.

¿Nuʼten ninin shianen nani taweri tatamahshunen paʼninsu yunkirin? Iminke kahtawatuwachinsu, ¿nuya nanan shaʼwiterinsu yunkirin? Aʼshatenenpita nuya nanan nuntawatuna akahpa kankanpi, ¿nuʼten ina? ¿Nuya ina nuya kanakeran yaʼwekamare aʼna taweri nimara tatamahsunen kenanpu? Iʼwariake iʼshasu peʼnate parihchi taʼarin, ¿ku nuya kankaeran ayarin tatamahsunen wentakamare?
Tahshiachin sami warin paʼanke, nuya kankankeran paʼterinsu aʼpateke, inapuchin piyapiruʼsa nahkaranchachin paʼantarinen.
Weʼkama waʼwarauʼsa. Mahshuya nunterin ina waʼwaraʼwa uʼnaike nininsu, inaran aʼna pantaʼpi aʼnira kerin ama ahkete sehtekamare.
Ina sanapi aresemare atarinen nikech9ina

Kankunpatui aʼna mamapaya piʼshitarinsu kenanaisu nunterai. Ku nimara nuya nahtaninkui nunteraisu. Niti inaran masharuʼsa keparaisu iʼirateware peʼperai, Inake naʼkun yunkiatui ninaterai, ku nituhtatui ina kemapi yunisaraisu ina ninanuke ihpurawanta yaʼwerarin inake.
Nimara yaʼihpia mercado nininke kepapun.

¿Unpurinta sanapisu waʼwin sapure nihsapachinsu? Inari yaʼihpi tahshi newerin inaran ihpurin nuya kankantamare. ¿Nuʼten nihka tuhpi mamaruʼsa nuwantuachinpura kañupatera ina nihka unpu nuhsururinpu niʼnewa?
Ku ihse nuhsha paʼanai.
¿Unpu nihkatun sanapisu waʼwin nuhsururin tahshi naʼnewachinara? Uhsharan uterawatun nuyahsha ihpurin taʼtakamare. ¿Inapuchin nihkatun waʼwin itarin naʼkun nuhsururinsu?
Ina sanapi waʼwin ku kañaʼpi patapun, iʼshanaʼpaware peʼpepun penutunke kepakamare.
Paʼanapisu ku nuwanterinwe yamura kanpiakasu kuʼwara pantaʼpi keshiwachinara. Ku nuya shaʼwituwachinara ina kku nuwantapun, tenin ina sami mercado nininke ahketeware paʼtapun.

¿Unpuintunta kema tahshiraya keparanken iminke yahshin kashinuʼsa mahkamare? Ka nantipi peʼperarawe kema tuhpinan irataran. ¿Ku paʼyataran kareʼken sara kapakamare? Karinken shaʼwichitenke unpu taʼarinta nuʼnu iwateʼ naʼkun tewaitun.
Sami kamayu ku ihka yamura nuwantapun panka samihtemare. Ina sanapi ku hakteware paweretuwacinara, ina ku saminen ketapunwe. Mercado nininke ku ahkateware aʼpamaitu tenin yunsanken waniatun.
Kuwachi nunshanen aʼnananku.

Paʼanapi kemapi ku saminen yamuramare ketapun ku nuya pawerewachinara. Ku pantaʼpi yaʼwepachinsu ku paʼyaterewa tahshiachin sami yunihkamare. Ku nuya nuntawachinara ina tenin ku nantepinen mercado nininke ku kepakunwe.
¿Kuʼwara yunupiʼi nihkasuwe yaʼihpi uskuruʼsa paʼainterewa? inapuchin irahka ninewa, mama kahpa kankankeran pawaruke ninarinpua.

Yuhsemare, tahpatuku kanta ihseke ninawesu. Ahke nihsamara wahpuru waʼkikeran kankipun. ¿Kema tenan iʼshana uʼnaike pentuntapun? Ku kahsu nituhterawe. Nimara ninapun iʼsha sanuikawasu. Muhturu irininsu nahtapatansu shaʼwituku, ¿nuya?
Ina penutun nimara tehkapun paʼawa niimurapiku ama wiswan teʼna ashilaisumare, inawatuna ku iruhkapuna tahshi.
Nani paʼnawesu maʼsha naniterawe, nahpatun tenawe inanahpu taweri yaʼkirarawe ku kusharu inkanapu.

Tatamahshuya, ¿unpuatunta naʼkun akiruwa werun iʼwa semanake mercado keparewa? Kahtepu ina tunpurewa. ¿Ku paʼtun paʼanewa ku nihka ninaterewa ahketemiachin paʼtamare? Shaʼwituku tatamahshuya, ¿aʼnarahchin piyapiruʼsa paʼanterinenpua akitaimare?
¿Ku iʼwara aruse paʼanan?
Tata, ¿nanitere piʼpianteranta ihse wanikasu? Tunanewe nani kanuhtapi, kema peʼpeintunku unpuinsuna irahka tatamahsunewe peʼperinke.
Ku kansarawe naʼkun maʼsha kepararawe.
Ku naniterewa naʼkun kurihki paweretakasu.
Nikaʼtanwa iikeʼpa yapaʼpatera, kanpuraihchin ku nuyawe teʼwaterewa niʼtun.

tahsiraya kahtu nunun peʼpeatu ninanuke paʼsarawe paʼankamare. Manutapu paʼsarawe uʼmatu mama kuhsinake kahtawakamare. Ira yunsanke pantaʼpi akurarawe piyapiʼsa shaʼwitamare. Kurihki manaweke asukaru inaran sami paʼanapu. Aʼchinpeike niwiteresu paweretamare akurarawe. Kuʼwara kamuhtechin nihsasuwe taʼakeran uʼmarawe.
Nara kuteke nihsarinke tanapituku wenseiʼ, ninuhsururesu, nani naʼwereke sehterawe niʼtun, ahke nihpirinwe nunenewe kanuhtupirinwe pakakasu yaʼwerin.

Yaʼkunaike uhsharan nunterai, nimara waʼwaruʼsa paʼpinpita shaʼwitumarai. Kanuhtu kankunai, nunshakeran maʼsharuʼsa keparaisu peʼperawatui keparaisu. Waʼki naʼirakeran ninaterai, yunkirahpirai, nimara ku ihsu ninanu wekakasu nininsu nihka weʼnai.
Ku ahketeware yaʼipi taweri maitaran. Wankanapuchin nihsawatansu nunsha tanapitaran inake chinuhtaran ama tanpanen ichirutamare.

¿Unpatunta maikeran ahke paʼsaran, waʼwa nituhtu? Chinii aʼna iʼshanake kepararinken, ¿kuʼna nituhteran sahkaikeran uʼmarewa? Ka waʼwatahpu irahka aʼna iʼwaraya chiwerawe, naʼkun naʼnerawekeran ahpi kenaninku. ¿Iʼshana nuwiteranke inake wensereʼ? Inapuchin, nunshake paʼmawatansu, ¿nunshinakeware kepararinken?
Ina yamuramare saminen aʼpachin peinenke nuwanterinke.
Nunshake ninaku kantaʼ, yuhsemare, uhsharan maitarawe iʼshake irasu ninin ahke ku tihkichinachi ninin.

Unpua iyamahshu. ¿Unpuinta imuya inaran shiʼawanenpita nihsarin? Nuya kankankeran pantaʼpi iminewekeran kehsarawe.¿Nuwanteran kahtunun paʼanakasu? Nuya kankankeran nuntaranken, kemanta nuya nunteranku niʼtun. ¿Yaʼwetumarinken aʼna panka saʼya peʼpekamare? Nuya akankanteranku ihseke tahshiachin plaza nininke kenanarankesu. ¿Nuya nihka ninuntakasu yunkiate unpuinsuna yaʼwepi nuya piyapisruʼsa ninanunenpura?
Ku ahkete paʼterinsu mama askaru paʼain kurihki yaʼsurinsu kuʼwra uʼmasuwe tanpanankenen tahpakamare
Teʼwakeran peinenke paʼmarewa.

Nanpiun senaresu kepake paʼanamare, inamare yamura shapun nahtanteke kechina. Kashin mare ama aʼpatesu inasu aʼnarumare iʼkirewa. Pihshate ya ketuwachinen nuya nihpahinsu maʼpateke. Nuya nuntawatun maʼsha nihke. Yunkiahrawe naʼkun kanuhtapun ihsumare nahpatun irake chinuhteke ama ku ahkate peʼpeteransu paʼterinsu ama aʼpatesu.
Panka nararuʼsa wiʼsharapike inapihkeran nanitamare uʼmantamare.

Nimara ahketeware iʼwraya ina ninanuaʼwake kankunai. Aʼna sanapi yunsanke nihsarinsu nunterai, nihpirinwe ku nituhterai ina sanapi nunteraisu nahtaninpusu, Sami peʼperai kemupiruʼsa ketamare. Wensatui ninaterai, kankan yunkiatui ku nituhtatui inseketa nanitarai nuya weʼewatakasu.

Tatamahshuparin taʼnakeran ku wanirinwe, yaʼipi sehterai. - Ku nunatupirinwe kushatakasu inaran ku ya nunpirirnwe. - Nihpirirnwe iʼwara sami nahtanterin inaran aʼna shaʼwi shaʼwiterinkui. - ¡Ma nuyata kankanterai! Nuy kankanterinsu nani niʼnai naʼkun tawerikeran ku inapuchin niʼnaisu.

¿Kuʼna nihka tatamahshunenpu aminpitare niyuntunatuna yunkirin matawerita paʼan nihkapuna? Nani tahshiriamichin inapita paʼmapi keparawatuna pantaʼpi kayapi mercado paʼankaimare. ¿Kuʼna nihka kema ku yunkiran unpuinta ninuntawatewa unpu aʼpatakasu yunkirewa? Ku insharu inake nuʼiterinwe yaʼipinpua nuya kankaeran ninahtane. ¿Inseka nihka ina taweri nihsarin nahpuru kanpu kapini yamura kentapisu ni keterewasu inake penamuhtu wensewarate ni nunteresu inake naʼkun aʼchin yunkiate ni shaʼwiteresu?
Ama yaʼkunkesu, nani nunsha mentarin
Aʼna naʼneiru ku anutapun kemahkeran yunkiraisu, yuʼyuhsha; paʼpiraunta, nininenparin mehtenewekeran ku ayararinwe.

Nunentu mahshia yunkiatun shaʼwirin aʼna sanapi nihka manuyata kayurunin nitahpayarin. Nani taweri kantuwachinara paʼnin puesto de salud nininke inake vacuna ketupi. Inaranta sami tanan kashinuʼsa itupisu kapamare kaʼnin. nahpatun nihka waʼwin chinihkenaʼwa pihpirin, nahpatun ina sanapisu nanuʼsa shaʼwitatun iterin ina taweri kankiwachinara pakakasu yaʼwerin.

Yuhsemare, ihseke yunsan wanitewa ninatawa. Nimara wahpurusu ku ahpira kankipun winkikiran. ¿Tahshiraya nimara kankipun? Ku nimara inapuchin nihkapun. Kema nimara maʼsha nituhteran. Muhturu nahtapatansu shaʼwituku.

¿Kuʼna mamasu waʼwin ahke paʼpachinsu sahkatamare nani tahshi yunkirin? Aʼpetuwachina, ¿kuʼna kahpa akankantawatun shaʼwirin waʼwin unpuatun sami maninsu? Kemupinen akahpakankanin, ¿nuʼten ina? ¿Ina waʼwin ahke paninke nuya kankatatun yaʼwetarain ina wentapun? Ahkayanke ku maʼsha irininke, ¿nuya kankankeran yuhse yunkiʼin?

Tata, ¿inseketa tahshiachin samiruʼsa keparewa, iʼsha mercado nininke? Uhshakeran karinsu imaranken. ¿Ku aʼnarahchin paʼanterinen nimara waʼchi ninaterewa? Shaʼwituku, tataraʼwa, ¿naʼkun paʼanewa nanitamare yamura inaran uskuru peike kentakasu?
¿Unputa aʼpachitun ihsu nantiwi menta pantaʼpi? Yunkirawe irahka tata narakute wensate aʼchinterinpu kurihki pichitakasu.
Kanuhtukeran peʼyawateransu uʼmawatan, waʼwa, iiyunsanke nantenen ni paʼmuke nahpuatun wai nihsarinsu kushataran.

Naʼkun tawerimare yaʼkaria ninanuaʼwake paʼsarawesu aʼshatu shaʼwiterawe. Kuʼwara keike ku nihkasuwe ama insharu nunsha aʼnankesuwe. Uhsharan kusharunen anpike inaran iʼirate wihtetawatun chinuhteke. Nininanunenpuake wentawatusu kemaʼtun yunihsaranken.
¿Aʼnarahchi nimara pantaʼpi iiyunsake akureke paʼainterewa, inahke irahka mamapayanewe nani tahshiachin maʼshanenpita paʼaninsu?
Ku maʼshanewe peʼpekamare tihkirawe.

Nuya kankankeran weʼsarawe shaʼwichinkema pantaʼpinewe nunshinanke nihsarin. ¿Ya paʼamaranken naniteran kemari paʼantakasu ku nihpun kapamare? Nuya kankankeran nuntaranken kemasu nuya piyapinken niʼtun. ¿Kenan maʼshake chinihken ku nukitasu puʼmurawatun kepamare? Kankanewe nuyahpiachin kankanterin kenananke niʼtun. ¿Nuwanteran niyakawaresu nuya ninuntakasu?
Weʼkama, waʼwaruʼsa. Tatamahshu tehkatun waʼwaraʼwa uʼnan pihkeran inaura naʼwerinsu pihkeran ama ahketeware sehtakamare.
Ku tata paʼninke pakesu
Sami kamayusu ku nuwantapun yamuraramare yaihpia saminen ketakamare. Ku tuhpinankeran nuyawe nahkeranchachin iʼke paʼwantakasu. Nuyanterin pantaʼpi niketkamare ina nuwanterin tenin.
Nani taweri paʼninke nuhsururankuisu yunkirarai, yuʼyuhsha; ahke nuʼpake kemaura paʼsaran kiyahsu nihpirinwe nani ya naʼnerarai.

Yunsanke wahpuru ninatapun paʼpatan iʼsha aʼyutupinan kepake. Chinihken piʼi piʼkatarin yamuru iʼwariaware ku awantaran. Nunshinankeran iʼsha ku uʼusaran, chihpirurachin iʼsha nihsarin. Inaran ama waʼwaruʼsa anpuike paʼinasu. Kanpita kapini ni nuhkumaku ama kñapima ninanuke wekakamasu.
Chiniiparima ketuku, waʼwaruʼsanewe, nani kanuhterawe; kahtawaku nunsha pahturui yunsankeʼpaware kuʼwara iʼshana tahshiwasu.
Yuhse naʼkun nuntarai paʼnansumare, yuʼyuhsha; ahke paʼpiraunta ninuhsururesu ku tahkirarinwe ina paʼnanke kaʼtananararinke.

¡YUnkiran tatamahsu shaʼwirin insekesuna piʼisu weʼerin, waʼwa? Iratuwatansu ku kenanpatansu, ¿unpu kenananta iranen uʼmantamare? Ihpurawanta kahsu tatanewe yunlirawe irahka keparinkusu. ¿Ihsupita aʼnunameruʼsa nituhteke nani wachi naniantarewa? Aʼna taweri nunshinankeran ahke ya chiwerahpiranwe, ¿kuʼna iʼshana yuniran peiʼpa kepainkesumare?

¿Unpatunta naʼneitun iteranke nahpurini tahshiraya nuya taweri nihsarin? Nahteranku nahpurini aʼna yahshin sami puʼmui nichitenwe. ¿Nuya kankanchitunwe tahtenpu kushachiterewe? Ka nahpurini kuwachi sehteituwe.
Nimara chinpi tuʼnarumare niketapun.

Mamapayawarinsu iiyunsanke pantaʼpi paʼanawachinsu, kemari ihpura maʼshanen peʼpeterinsu kahtawararan. Nuya kankankeran unpu paʼterinsu nimara shaʼwipun unpuinta irahka waʼwatapuri ninesu. Nuya kankeran maʼsha paʼanaran inapuchin ku nunesu ayapun.
¿Ku paʼnan mercado paʼanamasu?
Unpua nuhsururema waʼwaruʼsa. Tata wiʼniawanen nunterin uʼnan chinihken naʼwerinsu pihkeran, nuhsuruku waʼwa waʼkirausumare iterin.

Nani kushatupikeran paʼsarawe plazake pantaʼpi paʼanamare.Aʼna nantipi menta kepararawe ku ahke paʼtun aʼpatarawe aʼnarumare iʼkikamare. Kurihki manaweke yamura inaran puʼpian pihshate paʼanarawe. Inaran niwitereike pakatu ina sanapi pawerechinihken apu. ku waʼkiarawe, kuʼwara piʼi chinihken piʼkasuwe uʼmarawe.
Nani tahshi tanankeran uʼmawatansu, chinihken uu tehke kiyanta nituhtakaisu, ka pikirawatun kusharunen ketainkemare.
Kanuhtukeran nunshinaʼpa inkane nahpurini, nunsha ninaʼiterewa, yaʼwere kahsu yunkiʼitu nani iʼwaraya iʼsha nukurawatu paʼsarawe iterewesu.

Waʼwa, mamaparin iraʼpa kehsha kepawachinsu, naniteran kemanta puʼpianteranta paʼanamasu. Nuya yunkiatun bolsa nisarinque puʼmuaran ahpiruʼsa paʼantamare, unpuinsuna ka irahka waʼwatapu mamanewe kahtawarawesu, nimara kema nuyasha piyapiʼsa nuntapun.

Weʼkama iya. ¿Unpuinta kemuinenpita tawerianpiterin? Iminewekeran weʼsarawe kayapin kemararawe. ¿Nuwantahmaran paʼanakasu peinenmare? Nuya kankankeran nahtanaranken, nuya piyapinken niʼnanken niʼtun. ¿Kenan maʼketa puʼmurawatun kepakamare? Nuya kankanterawe kenanarankesu ihsu tahshiramiachin nihsarinsu. ¿Nuya tenan kema ni nuntakasu kuʼwara ni paʼantasuwe?
Aʼshin waʼwin mare kahpa kankaterinsu ku puʼurarinwe, nihpirirnwe ku tananpitarinwe aʼchintamare unpu sahkatereta iminke.
Tatasu ku inauran wiʼnin iminke patapun, naʼkun nuhsururin niʼtun nani taweri paʼpayararin.

Nipayarinsu aʼna ninanuaʼwake yaʼwapun paʼsarin. Awaitukamayusu yunkirin aʼna nantupi katapuna inaran ayarawatun paʼsaran itapun. Nuya yunki yaʼwetuwachinsu nahpuruwre pake itarawe, ku naʼkun tawerikeran nahkaranchin nikenantapuna.
Iwata waʼwaruʼsa. Tatamahshu shiʼawanen nunterinsu ina inaura uʼnaninke kehpariterin inaran aʼchinterin u nuyawe nuʼwi kankan kepakasu.

¿Ku nihka yunkirin ina sanapi suʼin nininsu kuʼwara ya kapasuwe vecinos yaʼweterinsu nuya nunterin? Nani tahshiachin inapita yamura inaran pantaʼpi yuntunpi mercado nininke paʼanaimare. ¿Nuyahpiachin irahka nunsharuʼsa chinpipisu niʼnewa, inake nahpuinachin yunkipisu? Maʼsha paʼanpatera yaʼipimare inkanpirinwe.¿Inseka wachi ninin nahpuru taweriruʼsa kemapinpua ninesu nikahtawaresu?
Kunpuru yuʼnananen aʼnanankusu.
Kuʼwara ahketeware iratasu kahsu nimara ii yunsanke chinuhtarawe, nani kuninanke inkapatusu irasu ahketeware sahkain nisarin.
Nani kanuhtuwatansu taweri iʼwarayake, waʼwa, ku chinihken iiyunsanke iratekewe inasu shihpiru ihsawatun tuʼkuiru nihsamara, nahpatun chinuhtawatun iratantake.
Nunshinanke nihsarinke ina sanapi atari kayune paʼain
Tahshira kuwachi ahkete naʼneraran, iyaʼwa. karinken kepararanken yuʼnatapun aʼchintaranken tarahpakamare nahpatun nuya kankantaran.

¿Kuʼna nihka ina mahshuya nani taweri ira ninin wiʼnin paʼninsu parihchi? Nani kahpayatuwachinsu, ¿kuʼna nahtanterin nani wiʼnin wentaramara? Yaʼwauna awinapi kusharu ketupi akahpa kankantakasu, ¿inapuchin nihka? ¿Kuʼna nihka nuya nihkakasu ina anuya kankaninpu chinihken nihkatewa? Nihpirinwe tanan sehturusu akehkeninpu, ¿kuʼna nihka ina urunterin ama sehtakamare?
Ama tahshi iʼshana pentuntekes; taweriarinsu aʼpininsu ninake.
Nimara tahshiraya sami parin paʼanaran?

Kuʼwara pakasuwe muchiranewe tahparawe inaran kemuinenpita ihpurawe. Tatamahshu, ku ihse nihkasuwe ama kemaura tanantekesu. Nunenameruʼsa mahsawatun inpiitawatun uʼuhke inaran iʼwaraya taʼnake kewatun chinuhteke. Kanchiwatu yaʼihpi irake niʼnawesu shaʼwitaranken.
Iyawe nuʼwiterin, inaran nuya kankanterin.

Wahpuruke yaʼkunpatusu, taweririnke pakatu taʼnanewe tunpurawe. Aʼnapita nimara iʼwaraya pakatuna ku tunpukamare kenanpi. Panka ninanuke inkanakasu waʼkirin kanuhtuʼ, nuya nituhterawe ina. Nahpatun itaranken taweriachin pakeʼ ina wanirinkeran tahshi nihkamare.

Ninanuke nani tahsiwasu inkanai inake wiʼnapisas kenanaisu nunterai. Inapita nimara ku nituhpiwe inpita kiya nihsarai. Maʼsharuʼsa keparaisu peʼperawatui wankana ninanuke kepatui ninaterai. Naʼkun yunkirai nahpuru tahshi ku yaʼwerinwe aʼna waʼan nuntakasu.

Ku kahtawaranku nahpurini ku pen iʼchinpichitu, ku imiranewe irahkapuchin ninin wachi. Tahshinanke iiyunsanke kehparicihitu, naʼkun nihsha irininsu nahtanchitu ku nuyawe kankanchituwe. Ku nuwanterawe teʼwatakasu nahpatun ichitunwe ama patukuauwe.

Tahshiramiachinkeran maikeran kankirai sami mahshapisu kenanaisu nunterai. Nimara ahkerankeran ku nuwiterinpua. Ii yunsanke nihkatui ninaterai, maʼshanenpita shipirinsu peʼpeatui. Ku nuyawe kankanterai yunkiatui nimara ku insharu nuwiterinpua waʼkihkeran paʼsarai niʼtun.
¿Unpatunta nihka aʼshin waʼwin nuwanin tatare iminke paʼninke? Ina tenin naʼkun sehterin, nituhtupirirnwe iʼwaraya uʼmantapun. ¿Naʼkun aʼshin nuwanterin nihka waʼwaterinkeraware nuhkumarinsu niʼtun?

Aʼshatu, ¿unputa iʼwara peʼpeterewa, shinparuʼsa inaran ahshuruʼsa? Nuya kankankeran kemareʼken paʼnawe. ¿Nuyakeran paʼanterinenpua ku nihka puʼpian pawereninpua? Shaʼwituku, aʼshatu, ¿ina kurihkike tuma paʼanewa sami anpikamare?
¡Unpua¡Iʼwara naʼkun iʼshanaruʼsa pentuwiteran, ¿nuʼten? Ahke irateran, nihpirinwe nuya kankankeran uʼmaran. Nuya kankanterawe nahkaranchachin niʼsaranke nuhsururake wiʼnawe.
Nahpuru tahshi wairinke ku kahtawaranku nahpurini, nimara naʼkun yunkirawekeran naʼneitu iyahsha, nahpatun ku ina nanitere naniantakasu.

Penutuni shaʼwiterin tatamahsu aʼna waʼwasha shapuhkeran iʼwa piʼihpi nisahpun kañurinsu. Inari niʼnin ina waʼwasha ku vacuna maʼpateriun nahpatun aʼnarahchin yañurin, Nahpatun iterin enfermera nanike kankiwachin paʼawa waʼwaruʼsa kepaaʼwa. Inapuchin nihkatuna nuya waʼwaruʼsa suʼsukapuna.
Nani tahshi nihsawachinsu ya uʼmawatan, linterna kepake, waʼwa, tahshi uʼmasu aʼma iʼpatamare.

Iʼsha parihchi nuhteteke, yuhsemare. ¿Ahkeran ina nihsarinsu wahpuru ninararesu nihsarin? Ku kahshu wachi nituhterawe. Nara muhtu paʼmararinsu nihsamara. Inta maʼta kema niʼsaran. Nimara naʼkun pawanin kankikamare.

¿Aʼnanku gorra warin ihseke ninahsewe? Chinihke piʼi ihse ii yunsanke piʼkararin. Nimara yunupiʼi pihkeran nihkasu wahpuru kankipun. Ahkeran nimara weʼsamara. Aʼna ninanuke nimara kehparitumara. Shaʼwitu kema yaʼkaria tehkein nihsawachinsu.
Sanapi awaiwatansu ama ahketeware pawere nahtantekesu; sanapi kemupinen nanitupisu maʼpake, atari kayu nuya inanta ku nihpun shiʼshi maʼpateke.
Tahshiwasu nimara paʼmararewa.

Kuʼwara pakasuwe awaitukamayusu nipayarinsu nuntapun. Tewaru nanan shaʼwitapun nitewatun pakamare inaran tenin wenu nitapun kepakamare. Inapuchin nitawatun nuya kankatawatun pakapun inaranta ina nuya kehparitapun.
Ira wankan kemasu irateran tahshinininke, ku tanan yaʼkaria irateran, inakeran mini yaʼwan pihpirin.
Iwaraya iʼshanake peʼyawataransu, kuʼwra atahshiyasu uʼmake, inapuchin ira nuya niʼsaran nuya uʼmaran.

Mama, ¿unpanta ku iʼwara pantaʼpi ku keparanwe? Ya kahtawapiranken nantipi peʼpekawasu. ¿Ina sanapi ku paʼtun iʼwapuchin paʼanterinpua? Shaʼwituku mamaraʼwa, ¿yaʼihpi paʼanewa ku nihka yaʼsumara peike kapakasumare?
¿Nuyahpiachin niitun nimara mercado nininke nunenameruʼsa inapihkeran paweretamare ketrinawe nahpurini, kahpa kankaeran keʼsha paʼnawatun pawerechitu?
Nimara tahshira iʼshana imate paʼsarewa.
¿Inta aʼna ninanuaʼwake kemupiruʼsa nihkapun? Ina, nani tuminku, nihpirinwe muhturunen nahpunpiriun irahka paʼninsu yunkimarin.

Penutun nipayarinsu kañapiruʼsa nunenpu pakapun. Ichiwaitunaʼpi nunenameruʼsa matapun kepakamare inaran pakasumare aʼna wina nitapun tenin. Nuya pake nuya nihkatun uʼmake nahpupinanchin sahkatantamare.

¿Unpatunta naʼkun iʼshana aʼpininsu niʼsaran, waʼwa? Nunshinankeran ahkenanpirawatun yaʼnipiwatansu, ¿ku nanianteran ira uʼmantamare? Kahsu irahka tatamahshureʼken ihseke yuʼnaterawe, ina nani kuninnake nininsu aʼchinterinku. ¿ku sehturupuchin kankateran nahpuru taweriruʼsa yunkiatun? Aʼna taweri chiwewatansu, ¿ihsupita nananuʼsa shaʼwitarankesu ihpura shaʼwituwatansu yunkike?

Ku kaura tahshi kehparichituwe, ku inshariu kaʼtaninkusu naʼkun teʼwaitu. Ku kema kareʼken nihsaransu naʼkun nunansu yunkiitu ku nanichitu weʼekawasu. Naʼkun yunkiraitu, waʼwa, tahshikesu naʼkun sehteitu.

¿Nuwanteran nantupi nihkamare karinken aʼchintamare unpuinsuna tatamahshunewe aʼchinterinkusu? Imiranen sahkataitun yunkiransu chinunhtaitun.¿Nuya nihtuhtu kreʼken nituhtuchitun? Ka tanankeran inin keitu ihpura chachin kañarichitu, ku waʼkichitewe.
Ina kemapi ku maʼshateranta ku aʼnaninku.
¿Naʼkun waʼyanewe nansaitun nimara kema niwi piʼshiru keteranku, karinken ayanchitunwe kashinuʼsa mercado paʼanawatu?
Tahshiachin kashinuʼsa senapisu kepaina kuʼwara piʼi piʼkarara.
Ku uʼnaike paʼnaiwe

Waʼwa, tahsiraya nimara aʼshatuparinken kahtawararan inarinkean nininsu ina paʼanamare. Nani piyapi naʼwerinsu aʼnutaran ku ahketware aʼpataran. Irahka inaurawe ka, nimara piyapiruʼsa nuya kankantapuna kemari aʼnutaransu.
Nuhsururanken ahpi, ¿naniterawe kahtawakasu feria nihsarinke pantaʼpi paʼanakasu?
Nimara vecinos yaʼwepisu yunkipuna nunenameruʼsa aʼyutakaisu, ina nimara chinihken sapuʼtanankeran weʼninsu kahtawanpua.
Kahpa kankankeran tu tehsarai pake wachi, yuʼyuʼ; kemaura iʼsha paʼmarinke paʼsaran kiyahsu nani taweri ninararainke, nani tahshiyachin nunansu kahpa nihkapun.
Nuʼwiterawe, nihpirirnwe

Ama yunsankeran aʼkenanpikesu yunkiatun wahpuru ku kankirarinsu. Pakasu muhturu irinpachinsu ku nanitapun yaʼkunamare. Nunshanen nuya tunpurawatun pateke ya weʼehpatansu. Ituwachin kuwachi paʼsarewa ama nahtekesuwe. Yaʼkareya nihkatun ninake kuʼwara tuhpinankeran ninakamare.
Nimara penutun itarinpua kuʼwara yakushatasuwe imiranen paʼmuke, naʼkun kañu ku nipaʼmuimirakeran kañu yaʼkunterinpua.
Inawa piʼi nihsawachinsu chinuhtaran. Nara yamuaninke chinuhtaran inaran nahkaranchachin irataran ninanuʼpa inkanakamare.
Inapuchin kemanta aʼnapita nihkatun kahtawachitun, nahpatun kahsu naʼkun yusparinken iteranken.
¿Ku shapun waʼwaruʼsamare paʼanan?

Nunentunaʼpi yunkirin aʼna mamapaya unpu chaʼehterin shaʼpikañu ina shihpitanake weʼatun. Ina iʼratenen nuya pahkarin ama yun maʼshake nininke waikamare. Nahpatun ina ku shaʼpi kañuri maninwe aʼnapitapuchin. Nuyahsha shiʼanenpita nuntatun inapuchin nihkatun ina shaʼpikañu chaʼerin.
Ama sehtekesu uʼnan mare, waʼwa. Tahshira nani winkintantapun nanitarewa nahpupinanchin nunshake maitewa ahketereanke pakakasu.
Kuʼwara paʼsarawe ya itasuwe, nuya nahtanteke: nani tananke kanuhtuwatansu, wenseraran chinuhtamare uʼnan naʼkukamare.
Nuya yunkirai kuʼwra atahshiyasu nuwanterai peike inkanakasu, sanapi kunaniterinsu wanikasu kepararai irata nahpunin nihsarin.
¡Weʼkama, wiʼnawe! Kahtapini iʼshanaruʼsa pentunteran mamapayanenke inkankasu. Ahke irateran, nihpirinwe nuya kankankeran uʼmaran. Nuya akankanteranku ihpura.
Upua, nuyahpiachin wiʼnawe. Nuya nihkatun iʼshanaruʼsa naʼkuhteran niʼtun nani kankimaran. Chinihken piʼi nihsapirinwe nitewatun kankiran. ¡Naʼkun nuwanteranken!
Inapita nantupinen nihpisu paʼaina inapita piyapiruʼsa nihsapisu.

¿Kuʼna nihka nuya ninin ahpi kemupinenpita nuya nanan nunpi ina aʼna ninanuke paninsu yaʼwekamare? Kushatuachinara, ¿kuʼna nihka yunkipi ina narinwachinsu nani nunpachinara? Yaʼipi nuya nanan nunkatunan kahpa kankantupi, ¿nuʼten ina? ¿Nuya kankanchina insharu ahke nihpachinara nimara ni kenantapuna? Kahpari tahshike, ¿yuhse yunkipi iraterinke ama maʼsha upukamare?

Piʼpian ninake, ama pakesu. Nimara wahpuru kankiramara, nimara ahke nihsaramara.¿Iʼshanake nimara kemari kenanan? Ku kahsu ahke kenanterawe. Ahketeware ihpura waʼkiramara. Karuʼkun ihseke wanike naʼwekaware, ¿nuya?

Ahke paʼpatera, piʼpiyan tanta kepareʼ inaran chihturuʼ niʼnewa. Nani ahke paʼsawate chiwewatesu, nininarawate piʼpianteranta kaʼne. Inapihkeran iʼshana yunireʼ ina imateʼ nuya kankankeran ninanuaʼwanenpu kankimare.
Ku yaʼweterinpua kurihki paweretekasu.
¿Naniterawe karinke kahtawainken sami paʼanamare yaʼwere kema chinuhtechitun, nuhsururanken tatamahshu?
Kemasu ya paʼpatansu shaʼwiran, nuhsururanken, karinken yunsanke nikamasumare kuʼwara tahshiyasu uʼmakasu.

Kuʼwara paʼsasuwe maʼshanewepita yuntunawe inaran mamapayanewe nunterawe. Ku ihse nihkasu ama kemaura iʼshaneʼpa pakesuwe. Sharuʼsa nani iʼwarea iʼsha uhputeke kamuhtechin nihsawasu chinuhteke. Nani kankanpatu muhturu kamayuneʼ nanan aʼpataranken.
Ina tata ku nuwantapun wiʼnin ku nuhsurupinan suʼsukamare, imin paʼninke kaʼtanapun inake tanan nituhtu shaʼwitapun.
Nuya kashinuʼsa tanankeran kehke inaran sanapiruʼsa waʼwina nihsapisu ku ahkete aʼpatawatun paʼanteke, inapuchin yaʼipima nuya kankantarama.
¡Iʼwata! Panka iʼshanaruʼsa naʼwehteran samirawaruʼsa kemaran. Ahke irateran, nihpirinwe nuya kankankeran kankimaran. Naʼkun naʼwananken, waʼwarawanewe.
Nunshinanke nihpatansu, sami mare manansu ama ahkete aʼpatesu, ama naʼkun aʼpamakesu sami kamayu sehtekeran peinenke paʼpachinsu.

Niapayarawesu panka iminke paʼsarin senatakamre tenin ichiawaitunaʼpi. Tahshiachin nihka pakamare keʼsha aʼnira nitapun kepamare. Inaranta yunkirin unpupiunta ira kaʼtankamare, inarankeran inaura wachi uʼmaitun kahpa kankantukeran kankimaitun.
Ku inapuchin pawereʼitenen, iya, ahketemiachin nahtanteke.
Nuya yunkiatui paʼmarari ihsu iʼwariake, nani wachi tahhsirarin peʼperraisu kenken nimantarin.

Miʼsewe tanakeran ku uʼmarinwe nani tahshipirinwe, ku manta kushatupirawe. -¿tananke chiwerin? - Iʼiura, nihpirinwe tahshiachin nihsawasu ira kenanin. kenanpatera winarawatun yaʼkunkirarinsu, nuya kankanterawe.

Nunshinanke paʼmawatan, sami yaʼwetarinpusu inaʼtun aʼnurapike, piyapiʼsa nahteinenke mare. Keʼsha ku maʼsha nuwanteresumare ama ketekesu. Yamura maʼpateke peinenpu kahpa nihsarin waʼwaruʼsa ku kashitawatuna kushatapi. Insharu sahpun ketuwachinken maʼpake, nuwantarewa peʼsainakamare. Nuya niʼke ku yaʼihpia maʼshamare yuhkesu, puʼpian puʼpian nihke.
¿Unpuinta ina kankanterin ninanuke kankunpachinsu? Nuya kankanterin inake waʼwatasu yaʼwerinsu, ahke ira yunkiatun sehtu yunkimarin.

Ihpura taweriarinke pantaʼpi nantipike puʼmuatu ninanuke kepararawe. Manuhtu paʼsarawe iranta tuʼkuiru unaninkeran nihsarin. Yaʼipi paʼanpatu ina kurihki nuya tahpapu tanpanaweke. Inake putikake niwi arese maʼpateraisu paʼweretamare. Inaran kamuhtechin kushatamare sami paʼanpu. Ku tuhpinan yaʼnuyapu peiʼpakeran wekapu.
Nuwanterai nahpupinanchin kuʼwara tahshitakasu peike paʼmakasu, irassu nihsarin ahke mamasu nahpuin ikitarin.
Nimara ina mukaru nantipi paʼanapun.

Wahpuru ninateranke ama piʼirute nuyawan nininsu paʼyankesuwe. Yarahtuwachinsu, ama iiyunsanke kehparitekesu, uʼnanpachinsu ku chaʼehtaran. Naʼpiru wankana ku nunshanen puʼmuaransu, chiniiri paʼkipun. Ku naniteran winanpita panka pamake nihsawasu aʼpayakamare. Inapuchin nihsawasu ku wahpuru kankiwachinsu peike paʼmake.
Weʼkama wiʼnawe. Kara iʼshanaruʼsa kehken nantupi peʼperawatun pentunteran. Ahke irateran kanuhtun kankimaran, nihpirinwe nuya kankimaran. ¡Ma nuyata peike nihsaran!
¿Nuya kankanchitu ka ihpura niwi tuma keterinku nahpurini, aʼnarumare paʼwereitunke sami chinpi paʼanawatun pawereitun.

Mamawarin sami chinpi ninanuke kepawachinsu, naniteran kemari kaʼtanamare. Ira paʼtapisu naniteran kemari shaʼwitamare. Nuya yunkiatun bolsa peʼperaransu kepake, inapuchin kanta irahka mamapayanewe peʼpeterawe.
¿Unpu keparinta pantaʼpi aʼna ninanuaʼwake? Nunshake, uhsharan maitun, paʼpin irahka nininsu puchin yunkiatun.
Waʼwa, peiʼ mukaru nininke chinuhkawa, inake shaʼwichitenke irahka unpu peʼperaweta waʼwatapu sami kuʼwara mamanewe paʼsarawe itapu.
Nimara ku kema nahpuru taweri kahtawarankusu ku inkaintu ina sanapi kañurinke, ina yunkiatun naʼkun ayunkirinku.

¿Kuʼna nihka mamapayasu nani iʼwaraya suʼin irahka paninsu yunkiatun shaʼwirin? Piʼshituwachinke, ¿kuʼna ayarin suʼin paʼyaterinsu yunkiatun? Ninanu pihta nihpike inake akahpa kankanpi, ¿nuʼten? ¿Kuʼna nihka nuya ninin ina nuya kankantawatun ihpura yaʼwein? Tahshi ku maʼsha irininke, ¿ku nihka kahpa kanaterin yunkiatun iiyunsanke irahka yaʼwatun?

Ku nimara yunkiahmaran nahpuru ura wahpuru kankipun. Yaʼwerin taweri yuni piʼike nihsawasu ku kankirinwe ku maʼsha kepawatansu ku kushataranwe. Peʼpetewarin ku nanitaranwe iiyunsanke patamasu, insharu naniterin seʼwakasu. Nunshanenteranta ku nanitaran piyapi ku nuwiteransu aʼnankamare, inapihkeran ku ayantarinen. Naʼkun niaʼpaike misinu, ku maʼsha unpukesu nuwanterawe.
Mahshuruʼsa waʼyanen shaʼwiterai ihsu tahshi itareraike kahtaʼwainpusumare, kehpe tahshi peʼperai niʼtun.
Nuʼwitu pihkeran, ni ihpukasu ninin.
Kahpa kankankeran aʼpereteke kehparitawa ama tahshi teʼwatakasu.

Ihpura tahshiachin aʼna ninanuke paʼnawe nahpatu shaʼwitaema weʼnawe. Naʼkun niaʼpaike nani imin tihkiwatansu chinuhteke. Ku kemaura kehken iwe peʼpetekesu, iyawarin perahke. Ka wenantawatu sami nanpi tehkeinkeran keshiraranken.
Nuya kankankeran, ¿naniterawe ka iiyunsankeware kuhtaru peʼpekamare?
tahshiware tanankeran uʼmawatan, waʼwa, uhsharan iiyunsanke iratekena, tuʼkuiru ihpura puchin ninin inaran kanuhtu weʼsaransu.
Ina mahshuya tehsarin iikeran kañu kantirarinpua, nahpatun tenin yaʼpinpua paʼawa iʼsha inpiitupinan uʼukamare.
Inapiya yunkiapuna ama neʼwei iʼsha uʼukamare kanpuchachin nitahpakasu ama yuʼnamenpu ikitakasumare.
Ku kaura ya paʼnawe.
Ku nunsha ahkete peʼpeterinwe
Ikeke nikanpaiwatamasu, nahpupinanchin maʼsha paʼterinsu niketuku; inapuchin ku insharu ninuʼwiarama nahpatun nahkaranchachin maʼsha niketarama.
Tahshiachin kema ahpiruʼsa paʼsarawe itaran. Ahke ira nininsu kahturu puchin chinuhtaran ama ahketeware kanuhtu peike kankunamare.
Mamapayasu amin iʼshanakeran aʼna sami keshintawachinsu naʼnepun.
Nimara ina yunkimara irahka mercado nininsu.
Nimara tahshiwasu uhshara paʼmararewa.
Nimara keʼsha mare yamu niketapun.

Apayarinsu nimara aʼna ninanuaʼwa paʼsarin inake nihka saʼararin. Ichiwaitunaʼpisu yunkirin nihka inake nansawatapun nuya kankaeran paʼsarawe itakamare. Peinen naʼwawachinsu ama sehtekesu nuya kankaeran niʼnanke nani saʼawateransu.

Nunentu sanapi aʼna kemupiruʼsa yuniatun tenin unpu chaʼehpita iʼsha neʼwei uʼmarahpun. Inapita ku amuru tihyatupike yunihkatuna inake pusu nihpi inaran ina iʼsha inpiitawatuna uʼuhí. Nahpatun nihka ku insharu waʼwasha ku kañurinwe nahpuru piʼike. Inapuchin nininsu aʼnapitanta shaʼwiterin nihkatuna aʼna inapitanta kañukaisumare.
Yusparinke ya iteranken unpuinsuna irahka tatamahshunenpua aʼchinterinpusu, nimara aʼna senan sami ketatunke, kemasu nihsaran aʼna taweri paʼpuyararanku.
Ina mercado pantaʼpi kepatun nuya kankaeran inake paʼanpu.

Tahshiriamiachin tananke paʼpatera, iʼsha tenenterinsu nahtaneʼ. Ahke iratupirewa, iʼshasu tenenterinsu perahsarinpu. Ina nahtanate ira kenanarewa. Inawate nuya kankankeran peike kankimarare, kusharu kemarare iyaruʼsamare.
Ku ya paterawe pihshatenewe.
¿Ku nihka yaʼihpi paʼanawatewa inarankeran ina kurihkike yunkirarewa maʼsha paʼanakasu, ama inapihkeran niwitakamare?

Ihpura iʼwaraya ninanuke pantaʼpi kepararawe. Manutawatu chihpiru irá paʼtarawe uʼnanin niʼtun. Manutawatu yaʼipi mercado nihsaraweke paʼanpu ama nikanaimarewe. Kurihki kanaraweke nimiriu paʼanpu iyaraʼwamare iruhsarinsumare. Inaran putika piʼpian niwiterawesu paweretapu. Kuʼawar tahshiyasu uʼmarawe.
Unpuka waʼwaruʼsa. Tehkatun waʼan aʼna waʼwaraʼwa naʼnerarinsu nunterin ina naʼnerin chinihken uʼnakeran panka pamaterin ina ama teʼwatakamare.

¿Kuʼna waʼwaruʼsa sehtupi nihka aʼchinapiri ninanukeran paʼnin niʼtun? Nani tahshiriamiachinke, ¿kuʼna nahtaninpua uʼmantapun aʼchintakamare?
