Mamaruʼsa nuya nanan nuntawatuna akahpa kankantupi, ¿nuʼten? ¿Kahpa kankantu nihka inapita nuwantupisu kepainasu? Nimara aʼchinpeisu sehtu keparitapun? ¿kuʼna nuya kankatatuna yaʼniwipi tanan iranakeran wentapun?

Nimara uhshipaya kahtawararan iiyunsanke tanan kashinuʼsa piyapiʼsa aʼnutamare. Yaʼihpia nantupike akurawatun ku ahkete aʼpatatun piyapiʼsa shaʼwitaran. Inapuchin kiyahsu irahka nituhterai, nahpatun kemanta waʼwa ina yunki aʼna taweri yaʼwetarinken.
Nimara ina sanapi nuwantapun waʼwin vacuna nitaimare, penutuni iterin waʼwanen ina vacuna nuya nitapun suʼsukamare.

Unpuka, niyakawaresu iya. ¿Unpuinta kinihkenen sahkatamare nihsarin? Ihpura nihshiiterawesu keran nuya kankantu pantaʼpi kehsarawe. ¿Ya paʼanahmaran kemuinenpitamare? Nuya kankankeran nahtanaranken nahpupinachin ni nuhsurure niʼtun. ¿Yaʼweterinken maʼsha puʼmuatun kepakamare? Ma nuyata kahpa kankanteransu kenanaranke. ¿Nanitere ninuntakamare, unpuinsuna nuya piyapiruʼsa nihpisu?

Mamaraʼwa, ¿unpatunpa pantaʼpi aʼnira ina sanapi mercado niwi keterewa? Ka weya nihsarinsu peʼperawe. ¿Uʼmananke ina pawereanpu ku nihka maʼsha ketarinpua? Shaʼwituku mama, ¿paʼanewa pan iyaʼwaruʼsamare?

Insharu nuhsha keʼshamare ya ketuwachinke, maʼpake nuya nuhsha nihsapachinsu. Maʼsha ni tapirinsu mukaru nininsu ama kanpiakesu. Puʼpina yamura nahtanteke inare kusharu nahpunin ninin. Nuyahsha piyapi nunteke, nuya niʼke kemanta. Naʼkun yunkiahrawe tahpuna piyapiʼsa ya nunpintahpirinwe. Nahtanteke, nuya niʼke inapihkeran wachi naniteran maʼsha maʼpamare.
Unpua yaʼipima. Mama nuya kankankeran nunterin aʼna waʼwasha ira uʼnaninkeran shipiterinsu, inaran ama ahketeware nuʼwitekesu iterin.
¿Unpanta ku yamura paʼanan?
¿Nuya nihka ninawesu paʼanturuʼsa puʼpian shiʼshi keterawe inapihkeran pawetakamare?

Mama, ¿unpurauchin ihpura tahshiachin mercado paʼsarewa? kahsu weʼesapirawe nihpirirnwe imaranken. ¿Ina sanapi yaʼihpi nanpiun paʼanterinpu ku nihka puʼpian niwi maʼparinpua? Shaʼwituku, mamaraʼwa, ¿nuya kankankeran uʼmarewa kematewa naʼkun kusharu iyaraʼwaruʼsamare?

Tahsiraya ninanuke paʼsarawe pantaʼpinewe paʼanamare. Taʼachine paʼsarawe ahke niʼtun inaran aʼnarahchin piʼisu nanperin. Yurimeʼ nuyahsha akuatu pantaʼpinewe akupu inaran chinihke shaʼpu wekaimare paʼanturuʼsa. Kurihki wentunatu witiu inaran tuma paʼanarawe. Inaran sami paʼanarawe tahshi puʼmui nihkaimare. Ku waʼkiatu weʼsarawe.

Ina kemapi ku yamura ketarinpu niʼtun pantaʼpi kayapi paʼwerekasu nuwanterin. Sahkaikeran saminen iʼkeran manin nahpatun ku tuhpinamare kechutunwe. Mercado nininke nuya yunitun paʼanapun maʼsha kanakamare.

Nunsha ya pihkiasuwe pantaʼpinewe peʼpeatu yaʼkunarawe. Ninanu nunshinanke nihsawasu paʼanarawe inake yaʼwerin paʼanturuʼsa. Manutarawe inake naʼkun aʼnapita waʼwaruʼsa nahpuru tawerita paʼpi paʼanaimare. Sami chinpimare pantaʼpi aʼpatarawe peike kapamare. Aʼnapitasu kurihki ¿mare aʼpatarawe. Inaran manutapu ama nunsha pataimare.
Nahpupinachin nimara paʼsarewa.

Waʼwa, nimara ihpura tawri tataparin nara iʼke nihsarinsu kahtawararan paʼanamare. Ituwachinke inanahpu paʼterinsu ina nuya nunkatun shaʼwiaran. Inapuchin kiyanta irahka paʼanai, ihpurawanta ihpura nani tahshiriamichin yunkirawe.
Aʼshin ku aʼna naʼneiteranta waʼwin mare tiʼwatapun, inasu tenin nuya kankipun ka waʼwanewe.
Chiwewatansu, iʼshana yunihke ina imahke nunshinaʼpaware.

¿Unpatunta chinihken tanan taʼateransu, waʼwaraʼwa? Iʼshana pamatuwachinsu, ¿nituhteran irasu nichiwerinsu? Irahka kanta waʼwatapu chiwerawe, inake mamanewe naʼnetun yunirinku. ¿Imare nararuʼsa saweniraʼwake peʼshare? Inapuchin nani uʼmantawatansu, ¿kenanaran ira nunshinakepa nininsu?
¿Unpurawatun nihka ihsu sanapi paʼyaterin waʼwinawaya nihkatun? nani tahshiachin kuʼwara iʼshake pakasu waʼwin ihpurin. ¿Ina nihka niterinsu waʼwin itarin nani taweri aʼshin iinamare nihsarin.
Ama ahkete naʼnekesu, niʼsakechi ahpira mamaparin tanankeran uʼmarin. naʼkun paʼyatapun tanan kasinuʼsa yaʼipimare keshirinpusumare.
Ninanukeran wentawachinsu, wiʼninpita pantapi kechin inaran galleta tahpain tahshiraya kapamare.

Peike shaʼwirawe kuʼwara piʼi pihpiasuwe paʼsarawe. Mama, kamare ama yunkikesu, nuya kankaeran nani paʼsarawe. Aʼpayake atariaʼwaruʼsa nani tahshiwanawachinsu. Nuya kankankeran ninaku, nuya nanan kepataranken.

Tanan paʼtewatera, uu tenewa ni ahkenanpiwatesu. Nani chiwewatesu, taʼterawate ninatereʼ. Inapihkeran iʼnateresu yunireʼ ina imahkamare. Inapuchin nihkatewa nahkaranchachin ira kenanate nahpupinanchin peike kankimantareʼ.
Nahpuru piʼi niantarin nahpurini, nimara ahketeware kahtawaitenke, kemahsu nahpuru ku kaura pateranku.
Sami kamayu ninaterinkeran nuya kankanterin.
¿Nuwanteran niwirinensupita kirihkake nishirapikasu inahpiran maʼpatamare?

¿Nuya ninin sanapisu kain panka ninanuke paʼninsu nanitaweri yunkikamare? Aʼkutuwachinsu, ¿kuʼna nihka aʼkutupisu ihpurawanta aʼkutahrin? Kairuʼsanen winarawatuna akahpa kankanpi, ¿nuʼten? ¿Kahpa kankawan ihpura ina nuya kankankeran yaʼwerarinsu? Iʼwariarinke, ¿kuʼna ayarin kaishanen manuhtu nihkatun wentakamare?
Ku shihpitenewe weʼsarawe.
Ama iʼsha ahkenanpike; ina peikeware kepararinken.
Nani semana inapita kehsha ahkeran kentapisu paʼanatuna kurihki tahpaina.
Waʼwa, ihsu panka naʼpike paʼa chinuhtawa, inake yunkiʼitu iraruʼsa keparinkusu iwe peʼperinkeran.

¿Nuya kankanchitun inaira nitu nuninsu keshiranken nihka? Piʼtatekeran peiteraʼwanen nichitu kahtenpu newekamare. ¿Paʼyachitun nani tashiachin perahterinsu? Sehtaransu nuya kankanchitun aʼna nipayaransu nihsarinsu.

Nunentunaʼpi shaʼwiatun napurin aʼna tata nuya aʼpaitun wiʼninpitaru sapu kañu iʼwa piʼi nihsapun ku maninwe. Sanichu bote kankiwachinsu wiʼninpita keparin vacuna maʼpatamare. Inaran shaʼwirin ina nihkatun ku wiʼninpita sapu kañu kuñuhtupiwe. Naʼkun kemupinen nuhsururin niʼtun inapuchin niterin.
Nimara ihpura niwi ketapun pantaʼpi.
Ihsu sawatu yaʼihpia pantaʼpi nihshiteresu ninanuke kepararewa, ku nihka aʼnaken peike patarewa ama kusharu pawankasumare?
Ina sanapi shipi yamura nihkatun ku samihtenen ketarinwe. Ku sami yaʼweterinsu tahpakamare inkanarinwe. Pantaʼpi ku nihka maʼsha ahkete tuwachinara, ina mercado nininke ku paʼanapun.
Tata, ¿naniterewa panka nara yamuaninke chinuhtakasu? Kahsu iʼsha uʼuitu yaʼwere kemahsu irahka waʼwatahpun irateransu yukiʼitun.
Nuya kankankeran nipayarawesu ninararawe.

¿Kahpa kankanterin nihka aʼshin waʼwin taʼnakeran tewarin niʼtun? Ina nuʼten tenin, waʼwin nihkatun nani taweri nuya kankaterin tenin, ¿Kuʼna nihka sanapisu waʼwinnihkatun nani taweri kahpa kankanterin?
Iʼwata waʼwaruʼsa. Ahpi ahpiaʼwanen inaura kenanawatun iterin ina uʼnan pihkeran inaura kehpariterinsu, inaran aʼna shaʼwinan shaʼwiterin.

Nani yapasaʼwatusu, yaihpia tahshiriamichin paʼsarawe iterawe. Nimara naʼkun tawerikeran kankiantapu, inasu ku nituhterewa. Irasu ahke inaran kanuhtun ninin, inapuchin nani nituhterawe. Nahpatun waʼwa itaranken mama shaʼwiteke kuʼwara wahpuru kepararinkesu.
Ninanukeran uʼmawatusu nanpiun yaʼweterinkusu shapun tuma inare ni kanpiarai. Paʼanawesu kahtawaku tahpaiʼ, mana aʼna pantaʼpi kechinken.
Nuʼwitere pihkeran, ni ihpurewa.
Ina nuyahkeran bolsa peʼpein iʼsha ira kepachin, nunshake nanpewachinsu ama ahtachinsu.
¿Kanupiruʼsa peʼpearewa iratereke awantamare, ku nihka kayapiruʼsa kepararewa inake yaʼpiwachin nuyatahpun?
Kuʼwara tahshiyasu nimara uʼmararewa.
